怒氣
pages.wikitext:
{{仍需翻譯}}[[Category:遊戲公式]] 部份{{Warrior}}技能是由{{adrenaline}}而不是{{energy}}來推動的。每一次{{Warrior}}攻擊命中或是被打中，角色的{{adrenaline}}就會慢慢上升。有些技能會提升{{adrenaline}}的提升速度, 而另一些會把{{adrenaline}}耗盡。 ==怒氣點數== 怒氣其實是用點數而不是擊數來計算的。每一擊會加 25 點數，而技能描述中的擊數是實際需要點數的無條件進位換算。
每一個使用到{{adrenaline}}的技能都有自己的{{adrenaline}}值。技能會出現上升的火焰,代表{{adrenaline}}由0到滿的過程。
以下的表格顯示出各技能所需要的{{adrenaline}}點數。 {| border="1" ! 擊數!! {{Skill}} !! 點數 |- align="left" | 4 || {{Cleave}}, {{Battle Rage}}, {{Rush}}, {{Riposte}}, {{"Fear Me!"}}, {{"Watch Yourself!"}}, || 80 |- align="left" | 41 || {{Sever Artery}}, {{Counter Blow}} || 100 |- align="left" | 5 || {{Penetrating Blow}} || 120 |- align="left" | 6 || {{Disrupting Chop}}, {{Heavy Blow}}, {{Staggering Blow}}, {{Hammer Bash}} || 140 |- align="left" | 7 || {{Eviscerate}}, {{Axe Rake}}, {{Dismember}}, {{Mighty Blow}}, {{Devastating Hammer}}, {{Defy Pain}}, {{Gash}} || 160 |- align="left" | 71 || || 180 |- align="left" | 8 || {{Axe Twist}}, {{Executioner's Strike}}, {{Earth Shaker}}, {{Galrath Slash}}, {{Bonetti's Defense}} || 200 |- align="left" | 9 || {{Skull Crack}} || 220 |- align="left" | 10 || {{Backbreaker}}, {{Final Thrust}} || 240 |} 1 "四擊數"技能並不代表"擊中四次"便可以使用. 表格中的怒氣點數呈線性成長;所謂的"所需擊數"只是為了能用更簡便的方法來表示技能. 一個表格中的"擊數"可能代表的怒氣點數為20-25. 而一個真正的"打擊"則為固定的25怒氣點數. ===獲得怒氣=== 你必須獲得足夠的怒氣才能使用技能表上的怒氣系技能.
每次擊中時獲得25點怒氣值.
每當失去體力上限1%時，獲得1點怒氣.
每失去25%體力時，你獲得相當於一次成功攻擊的怒氣值.這包含了遠距攻擊對你造成的傷害，但並不包含 {{health degeneration}}.基本上,四擊數技能只需擊中三次便可以使用,因為你同時受到攻擊,當然對手必須在攻擊你... *{{Soothing Images}} 將使你無法獲得怒氣.在此效果下，你仍然可以使用已經滿載的怒氣技能; 這個效果只是避免你再獲得怒氣. ===使用怒氣=== 怒氣技能只有在滿載怒氣時可以使用.這些技能將不損耗能量. 每當你使用一個怒氣技能,所有裝備中的怒氣技能將損失25點怒氣值.這25點怒氣可以在下一次的攻擊中補回(包含怒氣攻擊本身),或是損失等同於25%體力最大值的體力. ===怒氣喪失=== 怒氣喪失即代表所有裝備中的怒氣系技能取消其滿載狀態. 若在20秒之內未受到攻擊或是攻擊便會喪失所有怒氣. *有些戰士技能會有這樣的效果"...失去所有怒氣." 這些技能分別是: {{Hammer Bash}}, {{Heavy Blow}}, {{Wild Blow}},以及 {{Final Thrust}}. * 當受到{{Sympathetic Visage}}此加持的目標遭到攻擊時，將導致該目標周圍敵人"全部"怒氣喪失. ==加速獲得怒氣的技能== *With {{Berserker Stance}} 你每次近身攻擊獲得31.25怒氣點數(而非一般的25). *With {{"For Great Justice!"}} 所有你獲得的怒氣值增加50%. *With {{Battle Rage}} 每次攻擊獲得50怒氣點數. *With {{"To the Limit!"}} 依範圍內的敵人數獲得怒氣點數，一名25 (最多25...125). *With {{Wary Stance}} 每格檔一次近身攻擊技能獲得25點怒氣點數. *With {{Ferocious Strike}} 當你的寵物命中時獲得?怒氣點數. *With {{Balthazar's Spirit}} 每次受到傷害時獲得2..5怒氣點數. *With {{Dark Fury}} 每次擊中獲得額外25怒氣點數. == Reference == Research done by Ensign and Silmor. [http://www.guildwarsguru.com/forum/showthread.php?t=49539 Original GW Guru thread].

pages.title: 悲傷冰谷
pages.wikitext:
{{仍需翻譯}}
[[圖片:19-Ice_Caves.jpg|thumb|180px|悲傷冰谷任務攻略]]
==Description==
''The area surrounding this {{Dwarf|Dwarven}} city is dotted with numerous icy caverns that, when the wind whips through them, make a mournful sound reminiscent of a crying woman. Waterways, frozen solid year round, wind through the land here, but the resourceful Dwarves have found a way to navigate them by building {{ice ship|large ships that skate atop the ice}}.''

==NPCs==
*{{Blade Scout Shelby}}
*{{Gordok}} ({{Merchant}})
*{{Xunlai Agent}} ({{Storage}})
*{{Henchmen}} in {{Ice Caves of Sorrow}} are Level 20
** {{Little Thom}} (Brawler)
** {{Claude}} (Cultist)
** {{Dunham}} (Enchanter)
** {{Reyna}} (Archer)
** {{Orion}} (Mage)
** {{Stefan}} (Fighter)
** {{Alesia}} (Healer)
** {{Lina}} (Protector)

==Exits==
*{{Talus Chute}}

==Mission Objectives ==
Rescue {{Evennia}}
* Find a way into the holding area.
* Break Evennia out of her cell.
* Escape with Evennia to the awaiting {{ice ship}}.
* '''BONUS''' Return news of {{Rornak Stonesledge}} to {{Hamdor Grandaxe}}.

==Background== 
The truth about the {{White Mantle}} has been revealed. They are a cult worshipping strange beings known as the {{Mursaat}}. Having achieved {{Ascension}}, you are now (supposedly) ready to return to save the {{Shining Blade}} and stop the White Mantle. While you were away, the White Mantle have cornered the Shining Blade into the {{Shiverpeak Mountains}} and have captured both {{Evennia}} and {{Saidra}}, and now plan to sacrifice them on the Shiverpeak {{Bloodstone}}.

==Primary==
You begin the mission facing a group of {{Pinesoul}}s and {{Ice Imp}}s. Beware, because near them there will be a group of {{Mursaat Elementalist}}s. They are the floating beings with golden outfits and black tentacles coming out of their backs. Avoid them at all cost. All Mursaat (this includes spell casters as well as {{Jade Armor}}s and {{Jade Bow}}s) have a power called {{Spectral Agony}}. For now, this power will wipe out your entire party in a matter of seconds. It will massively drain away your health.

Sneak around the Mursaat and head left. You will come across an area being pounded by seige weapons and several groups of {{Stone Summit}}. Kill them and pass the seige area. You will see a bridge and a way down onto an icy path (where the Stone Summit have set up their seige weapons). Go onto the ice and destroy the group protecting the first seige weapon and then the second. Fire the second weapon (point A) and you will see a cut scene where a herd of Yaks rampages through the White Mantle encampment and helps destroy the seige weapons and forces for you. ('''Note''': Do not skip the cut scene. Skipping this cut scene can prevent the whole party from getting a morale boost for destroying the catapults. You should get 8%.)

Now, go back up and cross the bridge into the White Mantle camp. Immediately up the hill will be a gate guarded by Jade Armors. Avoid them. If you continue to the left of that gate, you will find a path around to another door guarded by the less imposing White Mantle. Kill the patrols, grab a keg from the nearby powder station (point B) and blow the door away. 

You will enter an ice cave. If you keep to the left side of the cave, you will be able to go around all the Mursaat groups (facing a few White Mantle groups) and out into an area that has a circular path with a pit in the middle. Evennia and Saidra are opposite to you on this circle (point C). You can go either left or right around the pit, but there is one patrol of Mursaat to avoid, which is easier if you go left. Then there is a patrol of {{White Mantle Savant}}s and {{White Mantle Sycophant|Sycophants}}, which you can take out. There you will find a cave that will take you around the left side of the circle to very near the cell. There is another patrol of Mursaat to dodge here. Get a keg from the nearby powder station (point D) and blow the cell door.

A cut scene will show you that Saidra sacrificed herself for you. Now you will need to blow a gate, then run Evennia to the ship. Follow the red path on the map to the {{ice ship}} (point E). 

===Notes=== 
Despite her assertion that you should stop for nothing, Evennia will stop and engage any enemy that crosses her path. If you wish to run, keep an eye on her; if she stops to engage, you will have to engage too.

When you near the ship (point E) there will be some Stone Summit (with a boss) engaging the dwarves that run the ship. It is not confirmed if they actually wipe out the crew if you move too slowly. Do not wait to find out. As soon as you can, engage them and destroy them.

The Mursaat following you (a large host that will emerge after you come out of a small cave past Evennia's cell) are very slow. You do not need to panic: engaging every Stone Summit group on the way does little to worsen your chances of making it. The Mursaat will be wiped out by catapult fire near the end of the path to the boat.

''Tip 1:'' If you are having trouble keeping Evennia alive, you can leave Evennia and Saidra inside their prison and move ahead without Evennia, keeping ahead of the large Mursaat group and clearing the route of Stone Summit as usual, but with no fear of Evennia dying.  For their part, the Mursaat will still follow slowly behind you, but you can take cover down the hill from the bridge and wait as they obligingly get themselves killed by Stone Summit siege weapon fire.  Then simply go back, retrieve Evennia, and proceed normally to kill the few remaining Stone Summit and get to the ship.  

''Tip 2:'' You can also fetch Evennia and then let the Mursaat get ahead of you.  They'll slice through the Stone Summit and then get themselves killed by siege weapon fire.  Follow them at a distance, and once they've done your work for you and gotten killed, proceed as described above. Note: It has happened that the Mursaat have got stuck on the northernmost part of the path, before reaching the area where they are killed. If this happens, try sending a party member to try to lure them ahead.

==Bonus==
The bonus in this mission is rather straightforward, but requires that you fight at least two groups of Mursaat. At this point, you probably have no {{infusion}} on your armor (next mission) and so you cannot stand up to the Mursaat. However, if you run all the way up to {{Mineral Springs}} before this mission and find the seer there, he can infuse your armor.

Anyway, the bonus is to rescue an imprisoned dwarf. There are two parts to this bonus:

# The prisoner, Rornak Stonesledge, is located in a cell that is inside the ice cave you took to get to the circular path. Before exiting the cave, you will see a path in the cave to the right (green path on map). This path is guarded by Jade Armors. Fight them, and then fight the Mursaat spell-casters after them. You will then get to a locked door (point 2); blow it open with a powder keg (powder stations at point A and point D). This door leads to a snowy path guarded by White Mantle; at the end you will find a small cell with Rornak inside (you'll need to blow it up to speak to him).
# There is a second dwarf, Hamdor Grandaxe, who is looking for the prisoner. He can be found after rescuing Evennia. After you blow the gate to flee, you will enter a short ice cave. After you come out, you will see a path and a large number of Mursaat coming from your right. Evennia will ask you to run; ignore her advice and wait at the exit from the caves. The group of Mursaat will pass from the right to the left. Now go where they came from and you should see Hamdor there (point 3).

Now you can actually go about doing this bonus in either order:
* Free Rornak and have him follow you to Hamdor.
* Speak to Hamdor; he'll ask you to look for Rornak. Go back and free Rornak and he'll thank you and you'll get the bonus (with the added benefit of not having him follow you). 

Either way, you will notice that when you come out of the cave to speak to Hamdor, the large host of Mursaat will appear and will be ahead of you on your way to the boat. This is not as bleak as it seems. You can just follow them slowly, and the catapults of the Summit will take them out before they get to the boat. If you don't want to follow the Mursaat, but want to talk to Hamdor, you might let them lead your group until they get to point 4, where they will engage some Stone Summit. You can quickly take the other route (the green one) to get ahead of them.

==Bosses and Skills==
The following bosses can be encountered during the {{Ice Caves of Sorrow}} mission:
* {{Arlak Stoneleaf}}: {{Cleave}}
* {{Virag Bladestone}}: {{Cleave}}
* {{Berg Frozenfist}}: {{Water Trident}}
* {{Jonar Stonebender}}: {{Crippling Anguish}}
* {{Hormak Ironcurse}}: {{Offering of Blood}}
* {{Darda Goldenchief}}: {{Mark of Protection}}

==Additional Notes==
The players will be in {{Iron Mines of Moladune}} at the completion of this mission.
Also Jornar Stone Bender is near to the ship and out of the cave battling some Mursaat. So if you see Jornar Stonebender once and you do not get the skill do not worry. You'll see him again.

pages.title: 戰士之路
pages.wikitext:
[[分類:冒險任務]]
英文:[[guildwiki:The Warrior's Path|The Warrior's Path]]

==Overview==
'''Summary:'''
#除掉斷崖的{{Orshad Chieftain}}.
#和{{Agastos the Brave}}回報

'''Obtained from:'''
:{{Agastos the Brave}} 位於 {{Destiny's Gorge}}

'''Requirements'''
:{{Ascension}}
:主、副職業不能夠是 {{Warrior}}

'''Reward'''
:1,000 {{XP}}
完成任務之後，可將副職業變更為 {{Warrior}}.

'''Dialogue:'''
:巴薩澤神親自展示了戰士的偉大。一位真正的戰士會讓面對它的人感到害怕，他信任自己的力量和技能，而不用魔法或小聰明之類的。你希望成為這類的英雄嗎？不會太遲，我能幫助你進入戰士的領域，但是你必須先證明你擁有成為戰士的勇氣。

:在沙漠的半人馬中，人們最害怕在斷崖的食人奧夏得一族，請你去除掉奧夏得首領。那麼，我就認可你的勇氣。

==Walkthrough==
Exit {{Destiny's Gorge}} to the south-east and head south to the {{teleporter}}. Beware there are several groups of {{Hydra}}s near it and you may be attacked while activating the teleporter if not cautious. The teleporter will bring you down into the valley to the east, where you will be "welcomed" by quite a number of centaurs. Follow the valley to the south-east until you come to a circular shaped wider part. In the middle you will find the {{Orshad Chieftain}}. He himself is not too strong and guarded only by two others, but there are several groups of centaurs patrolling around him so it's best to wait a bit and take out those patrols first.

It may also be feasible to approach this quest from {{Thirsty River}}. Go north-west to the teleporter that's in a narrow ravine; before you reach it, there will be area with lots of {{Jade Scarab}}s - don't go too quickly. Teleport to the area with {{Desert Griffon}}s (it can be seen on the picture to the left of the circular valley), kill 2 or 3 solitary ones and sneak past the pack down to the grassy land where you find {{Orshad Chieftain}}. Take out the patrols first and then the group with boss. This way it is manageable for one player with henchmen without greater difficulties.

戰士
pages.wikitext:
{{仍需擴充}}
==簡介==

[[檔案:1_WARRIOR.jpg|thumb|100px]] 

'''戰士（Warrior）依靠勇氣，強大的力量和近戰武器征服他們的敵人並且保護他們的盟友。他們蔑視遠距離的戰鬥，寧願直接揮舞他們選擇的武器與敵人近戰廝殺。'''

'''戰士擊敗敵人的方式是非常直接的。戰士擅長揮舞斧，鎚，或者劍，雖然多數人選擇只專精於一種武器。很多戰士技能需要[[怒氣]]，這在戰鬥期間使那些技能對敵人造成更大的傷害。'''

'''防守戰術技能幫助戰士迴避損害並且保護盟友，但是別忘了，力量是戰士最大的天賦，允許他在每一場的戰鬥中對敵人造成更強大的傷害。'''

==屬性==

pages.title: 找尋預言者
pages.wikitext:
[[分類:冒險任務]]
英文:[[guildwiki:Seeking the Seer|Seeking the Seer]]
==Overview==
'''Summary'''
#與{{Korg the Scout}}對話.
#與{{Onar Ironblood}}對話.
#Speak with {{Blade Scout Shelby}} for your reward.
'''Obtained from'''
:{{Captain Hugo Bronzebeard}}位於{{Droknar's Forge}}
'''Requirements'''
:None
'''Reward'''
:500 {{XP}}
'''Dialogue'''
:{{Thunderhead Keep}}被{{Mursaat}}攻陷了。所以亞里斯王對{{Korg the Scout}}與{{Onar Ironblood}}下了掌握{{Mursaat}}的動向並找到預言者的命令。傳說預言者能夠替盔甲灌注屏障來抵抗{{Mursaat}}的魔法。但是什麼消息都沒有，讓我非常擔心。你可以幫助我找到他們嗎?

==Walkthrough==
This is a brief {{quest}}, leading you a short distance from Droknar's Forge, through {{Talus Chute}} in a generally northeastern direction, to the cooperative mission outpost, the {{Ice Caves of Sorrow}}. 

The only difficult part of the quest is keeping the scouts alive. Once Korg the Scout is in mini-map range, a short distance from Droknar's Forge, he will be beset by a patrol of {{Stone Summit}}. You may have to move quickly in order to save him. If he dies, you cannot move onto the second step of this quest and will have to reenter Talus Chute if you wish to try it again. One tactic could be to engage them first. Also, try bringing a human {{monk}} because {{henchmen}} will not heal Korg.

Following the new quest arrow after speaking to Korg, you will find Onar Ironblood on a bridge near a sizeable group of Stone Summit Gnashers. He is usually not being attacked by these {{Stone Summit}}, so you can either bypass these enemies or take your time in killing them before speaking to Onar.

Finally, Blade Scout Shelby will be waiting for you in the Ice Caves of Sorrow to give you your quest reward.

''Tip'' it seems the game stocks parts of the zone with a different set and/or level of mobs, depending on whether you have this quest.  If you are planning to travel north of {{Droknar's Forge}}, or {{Ice Caves of Sorrow}}, you may find it easy going to leave this quest uncompleted until later.

pages.wikitext:
{{location box
 |image=[[Image:拉喀的牢籠.jpg]]
 |campaign=極地之眼
 |type=[[地監]]
 |parent=[[泰瑞亞深處]]
 |neighbors=[[聖諾谷]]
 |map=[Image:拉喀的牢籠map.jpg]]
}}
==重點描述==
地區: [[泰瑞亞深處]]

"拉喀的牢籠"總共有三層，裡面的怪物都是夏爾。

必須要和 [[末日傳說神殿]] 的[[怒爪 果恩]]對話取得[[暗藏的威脅]]才能夠通行整個地監。

==Getting There==
從 [[末日傳說神殿]] 南方出口穿越 [[達拉達山地]] 進入 [[聖諾谷]]. 地監入口位於聖諾谷西南角。

==任務==
* [[暗藏的威脅]] 
** 7,500 XP
** 1500 Gold

==生物==
===盟軍===
*{{x}}1 [[卓克納的烽火]]
*{{Me}} [["Blobby"]]

===收藏家===
*[[Cait]]

===敵人===
*[[夏爾]]
**{{w}}{{e}}20 [[夏爾斧術大師]]
**{{w}}{{e}}20 [[夏爾劍術大師]]
**{{w}}{{e}}20 [[夏爾 Bladestorm]]
**{{w}}{{a}}20 [[夏爾 Shadowblade]]

**{{rt}}20 [[夏爾 Avenger]]

*[[烏茲]]
**{{w}}20 [[Aggressive 烏茲]]
**{{me}}20 [[Shimmering 烏茲]]
**{{e}}20 [[Earthbound 烏茲]]

*[[嗜肉者]]
**{{rt}}20 [[嗜肉者 Harrower]]
**{{mo}}20 [[嗜肉者 Hound]]
**{{p}}20 [[嗜肉者 Nephilim]]

====首領級怪物====
*Level 1
**{{r}}24 [[夏爾 Warden]]
*Levels 2 & 3
**{{p}}24 [[Elder Nephilim]]

====首領====
*Level 1
**{{me}}{{mo}}29 [[食人 拉喀]] (will make a "tactical retreat" when too damaged)
*Level 2
**{{r}}24 [[Beastmaster Korg]] ([[Scavenger's Focus]])
**{{me}}{{mo}}29 [[食人 拉喀]] (will make a "tactical retreat" when too damaged)
*Level 3
**{{me}}{{mo}}29 [[食人 拉喀]] ([[Energy Surge]])
**{{p}}29 [[裂皮者]] ([[Stunning Strike]])
**{{n}} [[Flesheater]] ([[Toxic Chill]])

==獎勵==
* 3000 黑檀先鋒隊名聲點數

===特殊物品===
[[裂皮者寶箱]]:
*{{w}}[[裂皮者之盾]]
*{{a}}[[裂皮者匕首]]
*{{p}}[[裂皮者之矛]]
*{{mo}}[[The Maneater]]
*{{n}}[[The Flesheater]]
*{{r}}[[Korg's Recurve Bow]] 

==Notes==
*Be cautious of 烏茲 popups in the western cave on the first floor.  The large char groups coupled with the AoE of the [[Earthbound 烏茲]] and sheer numbers due to [[烏茲 Division]] can easily overwhelm.  Sweeping and pulling is key.
*On the first floor there is a hidden Dwarven Ghost on the path from the start to the area map and another one in the middle of the charr group that holds the dungeon key.  Use Light of Deldrimor to reveal them.  There is an unmarked cracked wall just near the second Dwarven Powder Keg Station, to the North of it.  It leads to a secret passage with another Dwarven Ghost at the end of it.  Taking the passage behind the cracked wall on the Westernmost part of the map is ''not'' recommended due to numerous Ooze popups.  It does not contain any treasures.
*On second floor there a hidden treasures near most of the [[Elder Nephilim]]s, and one just next to the boss lock.
*On third floor there is a Secret Switch just South of the entrance.  It reveals a passage with 3 Hidden Treasures and a Dwarven Ghost.
*On third floor there are two powerful necromancer bosses, [[Flesheater]]s, in the south cave. They use potent death magic [[AoE]] spells, hexes, and corpse consuming spells and surrounding enemies also do AoE damage. It's recommended to concentrate on a single target at a time.
*At the last two bosses it is recommended to stay behind the rock in south to block their spear attacks. Don't follow the bosses since they come back by themselves. Concentrate first on [[Rragar Maneater]], or he will resurrect [[Hidesplitter]].
*[[Rragar Maneater]] has no inherent health regeneration.
*Be prepared for a long session. Due to sheer size of this dungeon, as well as the constant need to stop, sweep and pull, completion time could exceed two hours.
*Players should display the [[Ebon Vanguard]] title [[Rebel Yell]], to protect against the [[夏爾]].

pages.wikitext:
{{Location infobox

[[戰承動物園]]位於[[gww:Great Temple of Balthazar|巴薩澤聖殿]]東北方，是[[gww:Zaishen Order|戰承教團]]管理的，可以在這為帳號解除寵物的封印。

==解除寵物封印==
雖然不能帶其他的玩家進來戰承動物園，但是一旦解除以後，帳號中的其他人物也可以迷魅或者購買這些解除過的動物，包含英雄的寵物也可。

只要把寵物帶給[[Emryd the Tamer]]看 (對話開頭有 ''Thank you! I've added the level...'' ) 就可以了，「不用」讓她收走 (當對話中選項有 {{yes}} ''Yes, I really do.'' 時，點選{{yes}}寵物就會被放生)。

有7種階段可以解除封印，依照寵物的等級和成長程度決定。也可以用[[gww:Zaishen Coin|戰承代幣]]和[[gww:Helena|Helena]](Zaishen Keeper)直接解除封印。

==NPCs==

*{{any}} 20 [[Emryd the Tamer]]
*{{any}} 20 [[Helena (Zaishen Keeper)|Helena (戰承訓養者)]]
*{{any}} 20 [[Salome|Salome (戰承物理學家)]]
*{{any}} 5 [[Silavor|Silavor (戰承自然學家)]]
*{{any}} 20 [[Wynn|Wynn (戰承訓練師首領)]]
*{{e}} 20 [[風速大師]]
*{{any}} 20 [[Zaishen Handler]]
*{{any}} 20 [[Zaishen Trainer]]

==動物位置==
[[Image:ZaishenMenagerie_Animal_Locations.jpg|thumb|275px|right|動物位置]]

*若同一種外型的動物卻有不同的名字(像是恐鳥和陸行鳥)，是算同一種動物。

==訓練區==
*給Emryd the Tamer看過之後，依照下面表格決定解封印的階段，之後帳號中其他人物就可以向[[Wynn]]對話，召喚出可迷魅的同階段寵物。
:(例如把20級的勇敢恐鳥帶去和Tamer說完話之後，因為已經是最高階段，可從Wynn那邊抓20級的所有演化狀態的恐鳥。)


===階段===

*如需連結本頁面請用[[Zaishen Menagerie Grounds]]

==餵食秘訣==
*巴友"魚魚"提供，為一種可以掛著練寵物等級的方法。
*準備:需要55HP(或者105HP)以及一組吸血武器、一組普通武器，請設定好[[Weapon Set|武器組]]，記得帶[[迷魅動物]]，當然也可以帶個遊俠英雄幫抓，精英可用[[堅毅靈氣]]。
:(55HP需要全身貼滿高級符文，在配上[[阿斯卡隆城市]]這個任務獎勵的附手，就算沒有也沒關係。)
:加入2個幻/祭英雄，只帶[[生體犧牲]]即可(記得點[[快速施法]])，設定"避戰"。
*到動物園後山找尋想要練的動物，敲他一下讓他名字變紅 (不要打死)，自己換到吸血武器。
*死過一兩次之後HP會變成1，英雄可以快速復活，又快速死掉，藉此來提升旁邊的動物等級。
*大概30分鐘之後，動物就20級了(都是Hearty)，這時嘗試換成另一套武器，就可以抓動物，之後帶去給[[Emryd the Tamer]]看，即可全部階段解完。

{{仍需擴充}}
==簡介==

[[檔案:1_ASSIN.jpg|thumb|100px]]

'''暗殺者（Assassin）在暗影中行走，如一條致命的毒蛇準備出其不意，直擊敵方的心臟，無論在任何地方，任何瞬間。暗殺者精通於他們選擇的武器、[[匕首]]，並且熟練於給予[[致命一擊]]，它能造成重大的傷害。暗殺者訓練有素，能有效率地連續攻擊，不會給予敵方反擊的機會。'''

'''他們精通於如暗影般行動的能力 — 暗殺者只穿戴極輕的防具，並且當敵方的攻擊施展時，會選擇避免留在原地受到傷害。他們其他的[[魔法技能]]包含能降低目標防禦的[[降咒]]，以及保護暗殺者不受傷害的暗影技巧。'''

==屬性==
*[[致命攻擊]] (主要)
**此屬性每提高一級，您的致命攻擊出現機率增加1%。而當致命攻擊出現，此屬性3級以上時獲得1能量，8級以上時獲得2能量，13級以上時獲得3能量。
*[[匕首精通]]
**增加裝備匕首時所造成的傷害以及致命一擊的機率。每提高一級精通匕首屬性，可以讓您在裝備匕首時出現[[雙擊]]的機率提高 2% 。精通匕首屬性的等級越高，會讓許多匕首攻擊技能變得更有效率。
*[[暗殺技巧]]
**提高暗殺技巧屬性的等級，許多與輸出傷害有關的暗殺者技能將會變得更為有威力。
*[[暗影技巧]]
**提高暗影技巧屬性的等級，許多與防禦及迅速位移相關的技能將會變得更有效果。

[[Shing Jea Island]] is the tutorial area for the [[Factions Campaign]]. It is a large island off the western shores of mainland [[Cantha]].

Compared to [[Pre-Searing]] (the tutorial area for the [[Prophecies Campaign]]), the tutorials offered at Shing Jea Island are more detailed and advanced.

In order to exit the area, players must be granted leave by [[Master Togo]].

Unlike [[Pre-Searing]], Shing Jea Island is a place, not a time and thus can be re-visited whenever the player wants.

Note that this area has [[Xunlai Agent|Xunlai Agents]], meaning that new characters can receive powerful equipment and lots of gold from the start from other characters on the same account.

==Getting there==
*{{Factions}} campaign characters spawn in [[Monastery Overlook]] and are lead to [[Shing Jea Monastery]] by [[Instructor Ng]] during the opening mission.
*[[Prophecies]] or [[Nightfall]] campaign characters have to take a ship from the [[Kaineng Docks]] on the Cantha mainland (talk to [[First Mate Xiang]]).

{{Linnok Courtyard}}}} ==Description== ''As the ancient [[Cantha]]n name implies, Shing Jea is the jewel of Cantha. Headed by the legendary [[Ritualist]], [[Master Togo]], the monastery provides training to students of all heroic [[profession]]s, including the Ritualist and [[Assassin]] professions native to Cantha. Graduates of [[Shing Jea Monastery]] are recognized worldwide as masters of their chosen arts.'' Located in the southern parts of [[Shing Jea Island]], Shing Jea Monastery is the most prestigious center of learning in Cantha. Under the directions of Master Togo, eight [[Headmaster]]s oversee training of students in their respective professions. The actual training is often conducted by other instructors or senior students of the monastery. Due to an edict by [[Emperor Kisu]], the Monestary currently does not accept foreign (from outside the Canthan political influence) students. [[Mhenlo]], of [[Tyria (continent)|Tyria]], finished his studies here five years ago (1577 [[Canthan Calendar|CC]]), and was among the last foreign students of the monastery before the imperial edict. ==Getting there== [[Factions Campaign]] characters can enter the Monastery after finishing (or skipping) the introductory tutorial. The Monastery is to the northwest from their starting location in the [[Monastery Overlook]]. pages.title: 施展時間
pages.wikitext:
Activation time, noted by the {{Image:Activation.png}} icon in game and sometimes also called casting time, is the length of time (in seconds) it takes from starting to use a {{skill}} until that skill takes effect. Activation time is also called casting time, particularly when referring to the activation time of spells.

Activation time has concrete effects on gameplay:
* The shorter the activation time of your skills, the more skills you can activate.  This seems obvious, but it's important. Remember, some skills have an {{aftercast delay}} which cannot be reduced.
* You can't move while activating skills with activation times or attacks with no explicit activation time listed.
* Shorter skills allow you to react more quickly.  For instance, if someone casts {{Conjure Phantasm}} on you when you start to activate {{Resurrect}}, your health will be drained most of the six seconds before you can cast {{Remove Hex}} (unless you abort the Resurrect, wasting some time and all of the energy spent on it).
* The longer the activation time of a {{skill}}, the easier it is for opponents to use {{interrupt}} skills against you.  It is difficult to consistently interrupt skills with activation times of less than one second, and relatively easy to interrupt skills that take two seconds or longer to activate.

== Queuing actions ==
While activating a skill, players can queue ''one'' other action.  This action could be another skill or picking up an item.  These actions can be queued even if the character must walk in order to perform the action.  However, while activating a skill with an activation time longer than one second, issuing a direct movement order (pressing a movement hotkey or clicking on the ground) cancels the activation of that skill.  Any energy or adrenaline spent on the skill is lost, as if the skill were {{interrupt}}ed, but the skill can be used again immediately (there is no recharge time).  Players can switch {{target}}s any number of times while activating a skill.  If the target is a foe then the player will begin attacking the foe once the skill is activated.

== Changing activation times ==
* There are some {{item}}s that reduce activation times, usually as a percentage chance each time you activate a skill.  
* The {{Mesmer}} primary {{attribute}} {{Fast Casting}} reduces the activation time of {{spell}}s.
* {{Glyph of Sacrifice}} and {{Glyph of Essence}} allows one spell to be cast instantly.
* {{Quick Shot}} shoots an arrow in half the activation time.
* {{Dazed}} causes spell casting to take twice as long.
* Some hexes cause spell casting or attacking to take longer, such as {{Arcane Conundrum}}, {{Migraine}}, {{Faintheartedness}}, {{Soul Bind}}, and {{Shadow of Fear}}.

pages.title: 擊倒
pages.wikitext:
*被擊倒的時候不能使用任何需要施展時間的技能，一般的擊倒為大約2秒，可以透過一些方法延長。最常見的是戰士可用的[[石拳徽記]]，變成3秒。
*其他技能如{{skill icon|噴發}}(3秒)、{{skill icon|背擊}}(2~4秒)、或者札格納特搖撼(5秒)。
*擊倒對很多生物無效，如不少Boss以及[[巨蟲]]等。也有不少生物可以於造成[[致命攻擊]]時同時擊倒，像是[[腐敗獸]]、某些[[巨蟲]]、[[巨人]]等。

{{anomaly|很多技能雖然沒有施展時間可是無法於倒地時使用，像是{{skill icon|燃燒盾}}或者{{skill icon|祕速紋章}}等。}}

pages.title: 旅者歷程
pages.wikitext:
{{TOCright}}
==2026年==
*'''12/29'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2013 11 12.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於二章[[gww:Eredon Terrace|雷爾登平地]]外面的[[gww:Maishang Hills|麥尚山丘]]探索區。前往[[gww:Boreas Seabed (outpost)|風神海床]]門外[[gww:Pongmei Valley|朋美谷]]周邊，獵殺[[gww:Island Guardian|島嶼守護者]]，揀拾1片[[gww:Guardian Moss|守護者苔]]。

*'''12/22'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2013 11 5.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於三章[[gww:Gate of Desolation (outpost)|荒蕪之地入口]]外面[[gww:Turai's Procession|托雷長廊]]探索區。獵殺[[gww:Water Djinn|水巨靈]]，揀拾1顆[[gww:Water Djinn Essence|水巨靈精華]]。

*'''12/15'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2013 10 29.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於一章[[Sardelac Sanitarium|薩德拉克療養院]]外面[[gww:Old Ascalon|舊阿斯卡隆]]探索區。獵殺[[gww:Hulking Stone Elemental|巨石元素]]，揀拾3個[[gww:Scorched Lodestone|燒焦的磁石]]。

*'''12/8'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2013 10 22.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於二章[[gww:Amatz Basin (outpost)|亞馬茲盆地]]外面[[gww:Mourning Veil Falls|哀傷之幕瀑布]]探索區。從[[gww:Rare material trader|稀有材料商]]購入5瓶[[gww:Tempered Glass Vial|調和後的玻璃瓶]]。

*'''12/1'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2013 10 15.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於一章[[gww:Bergen Hot Springs|卑爾根溫泉]]經過[[gww:Nebo Terrace|尼伯山丘]]進入[[gww:Cursed Lands|詛咒之地]]探索區。在卑爾根溫泉外的尼伯山丘獵殺[[gww:Skeleton Ranger|骷髏遊俠]]、[[gww:Skeleton Sorcerer|骷髏巫師]]、[[gww:Grasping Ghoul|貪婪的食屍鬼]]、[[gww:Zombie Warlock|殭屍法魔]]與[[gww:Skeleton Bowmaster|骷髏弓箭手]]，揀拾3個[[gww:Decayed Orr Emblem|腐爛的歐爾紋章]]。

*'''11/24'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2013 10 8.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於一章[[gww:Beetletun|甲蟲鎮]]外面[[gww:Watchtower Coast|瞭望塔海岸]]探索區。建議前往[[gww:Gates of Kryta (outpost)|科瑞塔關所]]門外的[[gww:Scoundrel's Rise|惡漢山丘]]獵殺[[gww:Mergoyle Wavebreaker|碎浪石像魔]]，揀拾3顆[[gww:Mergoyle Skull|石像魔頭顱]]。

*'''11/17'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2011 5 2.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於三章[[gww:Nundu Bay (outpost)|納度灣]]外面[[gww:Marga Coast|馬加海岸]]探索區。前往[[gww:Yohlon Haven|猶朗避難所]]門外[[gww:Arkjok Ward|阿爾科監禁區]]獵殺[[gww:Bladed Veldt Termite|利刃草原蟻]]、[[gww:Veldt Beetle Lance|草原尖刺甲蟲]]或[[gww:Veldt Beetle Queen|草原甲蟲后]]，揀拾3個[[gww:Insect Carapace|甲蟲殼]]。

*'''11/10'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2013 9 24.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於二章[[gww:Cavalon|卡瓦隆]]外面[[gww:Archipelagos|群島]]探索區。獵殺[[gww:Creeping Carp|爬行鯉魚]]、[[gww:Scuttle Fish|甲板魚]]或[[gww:Irukandji|毒水母]]，揀拾3顆[[gww:Black Pearl|黑珍珠]]。

*'''11/3'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2013 9 17.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於三章[[gww:Bone Palace|白骨宮殿]]經過[[gww:Joko's Domain|傑格領地]]，進入[[gww:The Shattered Ravines|碎裂溝谷]]探索區。建議前往[[gww:Basalt Grotto|玄武岩石穴]]，獵殺傑格領地探索區的[[gww:Sandstorm Crag|沙風暴．克雷格]]或[[gww:Shambling Mesa|震顫者．梅薩]]，揀拾1顆[[gww:Sandblasted Lodestones|噴沙磁石]]。

*'''10/26'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2013 9 3.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於一章[[gww:Yak's Bend|犛牛村]]經過[[gww:Traveler's Vale|旅人谷]]，進入[[gww:Iron Horse Mine|鐵馬礦山]]探索區。建議從[[gww:Beacon's Perch|畢肯高地]]外面[[gww:Deldrimor Bowl|戴爾迪摩盆地]]進入[[gww:Griffon's Mouth|獅鷲獸隘口]]，獵殺[[gww:Snow Ettin|冰雪雙頭巨人]]，揀拾3顆[[gww:Icy Hump|冰雪瘤]]。

*'''10/20'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2013 9 3.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於二章[[gww:Ran Musu Gardens|嵐穆蘇花園]]外面[[gww:Minister Cho's Estate (explorable area)|周大臣莊園]]探索區。獵殺[[gww:Sickened Servant|病變的使者]]、[[gww:Sickened Peasant|病變的書記]]與[[gww:Sickened Guard (warrior)|病變的警衛]]，揀拾5個[[gww:Forgotten Trinket Box|被遺忘的小箱子]]。

*'''10/13'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2013 8 27.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於一章[[gww:Ventari's Refuge|凡特里庇護所]]經過[[gww:Ettin's Back|雙頭怪隱匿第]]進入[[gww:Reed Bog|蘆葦沼澤地]]探索區。建議從蘆葦沼澤地前往[[gww:The Falls|陷落區]]，獵殺[[gww:Maguuma Spider|梅古瑪蜘蛛]]，揀拾1個[[gww:Maguuma Spider Web|梅古瑪蜘蛛絲]]。

*'''10/6'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2011 5 23.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

於三章[[gww:Jennur's Horde (outpost)|征納群落]]外面[[gww:Vehjin Mines|威金礦坑]]探索區。獵殺[[gww:Cobalt Scabara|深藍斯卡巴拉]]、[[gww:Cobalt Mokele|深藍魔克雷]]與[[gww:Cobalt Shrieker|深藍尖嘯者]]，揀拾2支[[gww:Cobalt Talon|深藍之爪]]。

*'''9/29'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2013 7 13.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於三章[[gww:Sunspear Sanctuary|日戟避難所]]往[[gww:Command Post|指揮所]]外面[[gww:Jahai Bluffs|夏亥峭壁]]探索區。可與[[gww:Rare material trader|稀有材料商人]]購入5張[[gww:Elonian Leather Square|伊洛那皮革]]。

*'''9/22'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2013 8 6.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於一章[[gww:Deldrimor War Camp|戴爾狄摩兵營]]外面[[gww:Grenth's Footprint|古蘭斯的足跡]]探索區。前往[[gww:Sorrow's Furnace|哀傷熔爐]]，獵殺[[gww:Priest of Sorrows|哀傷祭司]]、[[gww:Summit Warden|石峰看守者]]、[[gww:Summit Surveyor|石峰測量員]]、[[gww:Summit Dark Binder|石峰黑暗束縛者]]、[[gww:Summit Deep Knight|石峰深淵騎士]]、[[gww:Summit Taskmaster|石峰工頭]]，揀拾2顆[[gww:Enslavement Stone|奴隸石]]。

*'''9/15'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2013 7 30.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於一章[[gww:Ventari's Refuge|凡特里避難所]]外面[[gww:Ettin's Back|雙頭怪隱匿地]]探索區。建議進入[[gww:The Wilds|荒原主線]]，獵殺[[gww:Moss Scarab|苔聖甲蟲]]，揀拾3個[[gww:Mossy Mandible|生苔下顎骨]]。

*'''9/7'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2013 7 23.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於二章[[gww:Ran Musu Gardens|嵐穆蘇花園]]外面[[gww:Kinya Province|欣彌領地]]探索區。建議獵殺[[gww:Panjiang Peninsula|班讓半島]]下方的[[gww:Crimson Skull|紅顱]]強盜群，揀拾5個[[gww:Copper Crimson Skull Coin|紅顱銅幣]]。

*'''8/31'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2011 9 20.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於一章[[gww:Dunes of Despair (outpost)|絕望沙丘]]外面[[gww:Vulture Drifts|禿鷹沙丘]]探索區。獵殺禿鷹沙丘附近的[[gww:Enchanted Hammer (Prophecies)|附魔巨鎚兵]]、[[gww:Enchanted Sword (Prophecies)|附魔長劍兵]]、[[gww:Enchanted Bow (Prophecies)|附魔弓兵]]，揀拾2個[[gww:Forgotten Seal|遺忘者圖章]]。

*'''8/25'''
圖檔編碼 1 Nicholas the Traveler 2013 7 9.jpg
([[gww:Nicholas the Traveler|地圖]])

位於三章[[gww:Dasha Vestibule (outpost)|達沙走廊]]內的[[gww:The Hidden City of Ahdashim|隱藏之城 哈達辛]]探索區。找達沙走廊守門人 [[gww:Key of Ahdashim|哈達辛之鑰]]進入，獵殺[[gww:Diamond Djinn|鑽石巨靈]]，揀拾1顆[[gww:Diamond Djinn Essence|鑽石巨靈精華]]。

*'''8/17'''

pages.title: 柏里斯通道
pages.wikitext:
[[圖片:05-Borlis_Pass.jpg|thumb|180px|柏里斯通道任務攻略]]
==描述==

''海拔超過一萬英呎的席娃山脈，這偉大的山脈也是西部的{{Kryta}}王國與東部的阿斯卡隆王國主要連結。柏里斯通道是從{{Ascalon}}首都{{Rin}}到達科瑞塔通道的最短路徑。除此之外的最短通道位於遙遠北方的{{Charr}}領土深處。''

==NPCs==
*{{Beccum Reedly}}
*哈締亞 ({{merchant}})
*{{Xunlai Agent}}
**{{Henchmen}}在柏里斯通道為等級8
** {{Little Thom}} (鬥士)
** {{Claude}} (咒術士)
** {{Dunham}} (幻術士)
** {{Reyna}} (射手)
** {{Orion}} (法師)
** {{Stefan}} (戰士)
** {{Alesia}} (醫治)

==出口==
*{{Traveler's Vale}}

== 任務目標 ==
幫助難民們安全進入{{Grooble's Gulch}}並且找到棲身之處。
* 點燃所有的{{storm beacon}}照亮風雪中的道路。
* 查明{{Prince Rurik}}與矮人國王{{King Jalis Ironhammer}}協商的結果。
* '''附加''' 突破進入{{Maladar's Fort}}的大門。
* '''附加''' 阻止石峰矮人對{{Krok's Hollow}}的包圍攻擊，並且摧毀對方的投石器及包圍兵力。
* '''附加''' 點燃魔法信號烽火臺。
* '''隱藏任務''' 殺死冰龍獸。 



== 主線任務 ==
一開始和拿者火把的{{Ascalon Guard Hayden}}對談。他會交給你火把然後你必須要帶著它完成任務的前半部分。拿到火把後你必須點燃暴風烽火臺，一直到預見{{Ascalon Guard Tolis}}為止。在這部分應該不會遭遇到太多困難。

First off, you want to talk to {{Ascalon Guard Hayden}} who is holding the torch. He will pass the torch to you and you'll have to carry it throughout the first part of the mission. You need to light the storm beacons until you come to {{Ascalon Guard Tolis}} (A on the map). You shouldn't have too much trouble against the centaur patrols.

當你的隊伍遇到第二個警衛時，他會打開大門然後你就會得到新的任務目標。沿著路走，去拿矮人炸藥把會阻擋前方去路的門給炸開。然後你就會遇到兩個攻城投石器，把在地圖上看到的紅點都清了。但要小心怪物的數量還有Boss的位置。清光後，往左邊走然後啟動大門開關打開門進入下一個區域。(如果要啟動隱藏任務，就必須要再走得更深入，把門炸開然後看到被囚禁的矮人{{Rornak Stonesledge}})

When you reach the second guard, he'll open the gate and you'll receive a new objective, which tells you to stop the siege by destroying the ballistas. Simply follow the path. Grab a dwarven keg and blow the gate open when you reach it (B on the map). Here you'll meet your first two ballistas, which are guarded by a boss (point C on the map). After defeating the {{mob}}, run to the left and hit the lever to access the next area. (To activate the bonus, run further left and use a keg to blow open the doors where a dwarf is imprisoned.)

接下來的部分就比較直接了。清光你會遇到的任何阻礙，目標是把投石器給摧毀。殺掉{{Stone Summit Engineer}}來摧毀投石器。之後你將會遇到盧瑞克王子，然後亞里斯艾倫漢默會給你另外一個魔法火把。過橋後往左走最後你將會看到有三個暴風峰火臺分別被{{Summit Beastmaster}}守著，幹掉後點燃峰火，任務結束。

The next part is straightforward. Fight your way through the enemies to break the siege. Destroy the two ballistas as well (D on the map). You'll meet up with Rurik and go through a short movie, where King Jalis Ironhammer will give you another torch. Run across the bridge and turn left and you'll eventually get to three storm beacons guarded by {{Summit Beastmaster}}s (E on the map). Once these three beacons are lit, the mission is over.

== 隱藏任務 ==
要啟動隱藏任務，必須解救{{Rornak Stonesledge}}，在圖中打X的位置。他會請你把冰龍獸給殺了。

To get the bonus, free and speak to {{Rornak Stonesledge}}, the Dwarf at point 1 on the map. He will ask you to slay the Ice Drake.

冰龍獸是{{Whiskar Featherstorm}}。要進入他的洞穴之前，必須要用矮人炸藥把在{{Rornak Stonesledge}}後方的雪堆炸開。拿炸藥桶然後放在木頭那裏即可，如此一來少了木牆支撐的雪堆就會滑落山谷。

The Ice Drake is {{Whiskar Featherstorm}}. His cave is made accessible using the dwarven powder kegs.  Bring a keg and set it up against the planks of wood that are directly behind and to the right of Rornak Stonesledge. Once this barricade is destroyed, there is nothing to hold the snow blocking the pass to the left of Rornak, and it will slide down the hill and out of your way. If it does not melt away, bring more kegs and place them.

在前往冰龍獸的路途中大部分得怪物是{{Frostfire Dryder}}，和冰龍獸比起來比較難對付。這些霜火蛛化精靈會放{{Suffering}}對我方的隊員形成極大體力衰減，對僧侶來說是個負擔，要小心應對。

There are mostly {{Frostfire Dryder}}s on the way to the Ice Drake, and the beast itself is not too taxing (2 on the map). The dryders can place a strain on healers if not tackled effectively, as they cause collective group health degeneration with the {{Suffering}} spell.

地圖請參考：http://wiki.guildwars.com/wiki/File:Borlis_Pass_map.jpg

pages.title: 核心技能表
條件
pages.wikitext:
Conditions are negative status effects that are placed upon a character either by a skill or by their environment. A single character can only be affected by a single instance of a particular condition at a time, though re-imposing a condition will reset its duration. Conditions can be removed by some monk skills. Several skills, particularly certain warrior skills, only achieve their maximum effect if the target is already suffering from a condition. Each condition has a unique icon that shows up on the Effects Monitor, additionally, a creature suffering from a condition has a brown, downward arrow at the right end of their health bar. Non-fleshy creatures are immune to the bleeding, disease and poison conditions.

Conditions include:

* Bleeding, -3 Health degeneration
* Blind, 90% chance to miss
* Burning, -7 Health degeneration
* Crippled, 50% slower movement
* Dazed, twice as long to cast spells, spells are easily interrupted
* Deep Wound, 20% less maximum health, 20% less healing on this character
* Disease, -4 Health degeneration, contagious to all adjacent of the same species
* Poison, -4 Health degeneration
* Weakness, 66% less damage dealt in combat

pages.wikitext:
==3/13台港澳區域實施IP限制==
公告時間 2007.03.09  
 
親愛的激戰會員您好：

為避免侵害海外激戰代理商權益，以及符合吉恩立簽訂的遊戲代理合約精神，台港澳區激戰服務將自3/13開始實施IP過濾政策，該日起激戰官網將無法提供海外玩家進行開啟激戰遊戲服務、當日起開通的激戰帳號，也將無法自海外登入激戰遊戲。為確保既有玩家的遊戲權限，3/13以前申請的激戰帳號則不會因此措施受到任何影響，只要您的激戰遊戲帳號是在3/13以前完成註冊及開啟激戰遊戲服務的帳號，未來仍可於海外地區登入激戰遊戲、或儲值激戰遊戲商品等相關服務。

帳號申請方面：
3/13(二)10:01起，激戰官網將進行IP過濾，僅開放位於台港澳區域內玩家進行開啟激戰遊戲服務申請，非台港澳區域玩家將無法再開啟遊戲服務。
遊戲登入方面：
3/13(二)10：01起，新申請的激戰台港澳帳號將限定位於台港澳區域連線IP，才能成功登入遊戲伺服器。之前所申請的台港澳帳號位於海外區域則不在此限。

吉恩立了解這項新措施有可能對新申請玩家造成不便，在接獲許多玩家的反應後，吉恩立也立即與原廠的進行溝通及協調，期望IP政策可以不影響既有玩家權益。也希望玩家們對此措施所造成的不便之處，多多見諒。

若您位於海外地區的玩家，且在3/13以前就使用的台港澳帳號，若無法順利登入遊戲，請您務必透過E-BOX反應您的問題，若於3/13以後位於台港澳區域的玩家但卻無法順利開啟激戰遊戲服務，請您使用gwbug@nctaiwan.com信箱反應您的問題，我們將盡速為您服務。 


==【台港澳區域】帳號申請及遊戲登入注意事項 ==
 
 
公告時間 2007.02.16  
 
親愛的激戰玩家您好：

因應原廠全球化的考量與日後將實施的政策，預計於2/27(二)開始，吉恩立僅只有權服務位於台港澳區域的會員。

帳號申請方面：僅開放位於台港澳區域申請激戰遊戲服務，非該區域之玩家於帳號申請時將無法開啟激戰遊戲服務。

遊戲登入方面：台港澳帳號將限定只能位於台港澳區域之IP連線才能登入遊戲伺服器。

以上造成您的不便之處在此深感抱歉，敬請玩家見諒!

若您位於台港澳區卻無法順利開啟此激戰遊戲服務，請您利用【E-BOX】方式來反應您的問題，我們將盡速為您服務。


吉恩立營運團隊 敬上

==Odurra, Illusion Henchman==
[[Odurra]] is a [[Domination Magic]] [[henchman]] (despite being labelled as an Illusion Henchman) available in the [[Nightfall Campaign]]. She is from [[Vabbi]] and has a sister, who currently resides in Ascalon, believed to be [[Erudine]].

===Location===
:''Note: Found in all [[town]]s and [[outpost]]s of the following [[region]]s unless noted otherwise''
*[[Istan]] (except [[Chahbek Village (Location)|Chahbek Village]], [[Kamadan]], and [[Sunspear Great Hall]])
*[[Kourna]]
*[[Vabbi]]
*[[The Desolation]]
*[[Realm of Torment]]

===Skills Used===
*{{skill icon|Cry of Frustration}}
*{{skill icon|Empathy}}
*{{skill icon|Ether Feast}}
*{{skill icon|Leech Signet}}
*{{skill icon|Resurrection Signet}}

===Level 20===
*{{skill icon|Shatter Hex}}

===Dialogue===
:''"Hello, dear! Isn't it a magnificent day? The kind of day we used to have in [[Vabbi]]. My sister and I spent years at the theatre and the library, educating ourselves. But I traveled to Istan, and she went to [[Tyria (continent)|Tyria]]. I haven't seen her since. But I'm sure she's safe. Safer than us, I'd imagine, darling!"'' [sic]

===Quotes===
Idle quotes:
*''"Beauty is my job, dear. Luckily I don't have to work at it."''
*''"I find it incredibly romantic that people should fight for a cause they believe in and be prepared to die for it."''
*''"I'm a grown woman. I've earned my scars. The fact that I'm still beautiful despite them is a testament of my will and my dedication ... not my age."''
*''"I'm not just a role model, dear. I'm an inspiration."''
*''"If you only have two coins left in the world, buy a loaf of bread with one and a rose with the other."''
*''"Love is a fire. But whether it will warm your heart or burn down your house, you can never tell."''

Battle quotes:
*''"A pity. I almost thought that would be a challenge."''
*''"Crushing your mind is as natural as breathing."''
*''"Don't you dare get dirt on my clothes!"''
*''"I bought these shoes in [[Vabbi]]! Do you have any idea how much they cost?"''
*''"I don't admit to anything. A girl's got to have her secrets."''
*''"I don't think so."''
*''"Never wear those shoes... with that shirt!"''
*''"Smile! The least you can do is die pretty."''
*''"Those who live by the sword get ensorcelled by those who don't."''
*''"Well, here I am. What were your other two wishes?"''
*''"Women are natural anarchists, darling."''
*''"You're about to spend the rest of your life believing you're a chipmunk."''
*''"You're very tedious."''
*''"Your mind is like a stained glass window ... so easy to break."''

At [[Throne of Secrets]]:
*''"There you are! A brilliant hero and still looking fabulous."''

==Trivia==
*There is a Mesmer henchman by the name of Jurra in one of the Guild Wars Nightfall preview videos, the name appears briefly in the party window, but the henchman cannot be clearly seen. It is not known whether Jurra was an earlier name for Odurra or a separate henchman, however Jurra is described as an "Illusion Henchman" like Odurra.

pages.wikitext:
*[[gww:Feedback:Chinese_community_localization|最近更新]]，這裡可以看到最近的技能更新中文說明。 右邊的Archive可以看到稍早之前的更新。 *[[gww:Feedback:Game_updates|更新說明(英文)]] *[http://forum.gamer.com.tw/B.php?bsn=07678 巴哈姆特 激戰哈拉版]，這裡也有許多由熱心巴友提供的資訊。 ==2022 4月28日== 重大更新~ [https://rikey32000.blogspot.com/2022/04/blog-post_28.html 激戰亞洲伺服回歸] ==2021 4月11日== 被遺忘的彩蛋~ [https://rikey32000.blogspot.com/2021/04/blog-post_15.html 銀刃之路] ==2020 4月23日== PvE專用技能~ [https://rikey32000.blogspot.com/2020/04/blog-post_23.html 激戰十五週年生日慶典 更新項目] ==2019 2月6日== '''1.''' 商人多一道確認模式,可防止綠武與金武被玩家誤賣. '''2.''' 倉庫內每個欄位從20格自動升級成25格 '''3.''' 巴薩澤聖殿的戰承金幣兌換商 潔西 萊姆接受用100枚戰承金幣與100金幣購買腰袋擴充格工具 '''4.''' 巴薩澤聖殿的戰承金幣兌換商 潔西 萊姆接受用100枚戰承金幣與100金幣購買袋子擴充格工具 '''5.''' 幾個方便熱鍵添加. 例如 *開啟背包現在可以折疊收縮 *指揮英雄出技能快速鍵 '''6.''' 傭兵、英雄、怪物 控制技能的方式更新 *[https://forum.gamer.com.tw/C.php?bsn=7678&snA=20546 激戰1 更新 2019/2/6] *[https://wiki.guildwars.com/wiki/Feedback:Game_updates/20190205 激戰1維基百科 更新頁面] ==2011 6月3日== *巴友[http://home.gamer.com.tw/smalljohn20 肥肥][http://forum.gamer.com.tw/C.php?bsn=07678&snA=19915&tnum=8 整理]。 *在巴薩澤聖殿及各大主城新增一位[[gww:Zaishen Recruiter|Zaishen Recruiter]]，專給[[gww:Zaishen Guide|戰承指南]]的pvp任務(叫你去打RA、HA、GVG、CA，任務會給Zaishen Strongboxes，打一場就可以交了)。 *一章的泰坦任務新增困難模式版本，在解過普通模式版的之後可接。 *輸入 "/guild", "/ladder", or "/champion"等指令可以秀出公會emote，emote會根據公會的天梯排行做變化。 *Codex Arena現在可以使用的技能改為每天改變一次。(以往改變頻率太高了...對新手來講難以入門...) *現在GVG、HA、RA與CA都會給Zaishen Strongboxes。(box除了甜點跟節慶道具以外，還有機會會開出二章迷霧使者拿的那些武器，實際上就是戰承金幣需求100枚的那些武器的綠武版的樣子)。 :Champion's Zaishen Strongbox (贏一場GVG)。 :Hero's Strongbox (解Zenjal給的HA任務或者在HA連贏三場)。 :Gladiator's Zaishen Strongbox (解Zenjal給的RA任務或者在RA連贏五場)。 :Strategist's Zaishen Strongbox (解Zenjal給的CA任務或者在HA連贏五場)。 *在各個AB的據點新增''陣營間諜''，間諜的功能是將你傳至對方相對應據點。(例如你在勒克森的先人聖地點間諜，他會把你傳到庫茲科的先人聖地......) *公會天梯重置。 *玩家現在可以藉由輸入"/zaishen #" or "/zrank #"來顯示出曾經拿過的z箱頭銜。(例如你現在Zrank為5階，那麼你可以藉由輸入"/zrank 1" ~ "/zrank 5"來顯示每個階段不同的動畫)。 *玩家現在可以藉由輸入"/rank #" or "/fame #"來顯示出曾經拿過的英雄之路頭銜。(用法同上，#改成你想顯示的階數就是，當你輸入大於本身所拿到的頭銜等級，只會顯示出你目前的)。 *陣營戰相關的PVP現在不給陣營榮譽值了，只給[[gww:Imperial faction|Imperial faction]](以下暫稱帝國榮譽值)、巴薩澤榮譽值跟經驗值。 *在各個陣營戰據點增加NPC Imperial Faction Converters，作用是將帝國榮譽值轉換成勒克森、庫茲科或者巴薩則榮譽值。(帝國榮譽 : 勒跟庫的榮譽是1 : 1；跟巴薩澤榮譽是 3 : 1)。 *戰承硬幣現在變的可交易。部分用戰承硬幣兌換的物品兌換比例改變了。 *Jessie Llam(就是戰承金幣兌換那位)現在新增了物品。(多了金武可以兌換.15技能點+15k+100戰承金幣.) *Tolkano(托卡諾，你常換z-key那位)多了新的武器可以兌換。 *鬥士頭銜獲得點數的方式改變，從第二場就開始給你鬥士點數了，每連勝五場還有額外的獎勵點數跟Zaishen Strongboxes送你。 :(另外每個人的之前的鬥士點數都乘上8，鬥士頭銜每階所需要的點數也都重新調整，詳細看這[[gww:Gladiator title|Gladiator title]])。 *CA頭銜獲得點數的方式改變，也是一樣從第二場就開始給你CA點數了，每連勝五場還有額外的獎勵點數跟Zaishen Strongboxes送你。 *陣營PVP的獎勵提升 :FA楊木要塞現在每個殺人數給你雙倍的帝國榮譽值；當庫方完成神之復仇時，給原本雙倍帝國榮譽值(所以說贏了應該是給5000?有點不確定)；勒方破壞庫方大門得到的榮譽值提升至500帝國榮譽值(原本300，所以說勒方贏一場給3500帝國榮譽值)。 :JQ翡翠礦場現在每個殺人數給你雙倍的帝國榮譽值；JQ現在每運送回來一顆翡翠給300帝國榮譽值(原本250，也就是說現在贏一場是4000帝國榮譽值)。 ==2011 2月17日== *神喚大量技能改變，見[[神喚使變革]]頁。 *{{Skill icon|強光}} 持續 10 秒，下一次你造成元素傷害時，目標附近的敵人也會受到該傷害值的 {{gr|40|50}}% 傷害。
  *'''{{Skill icon|阿蘇拉之掠}} 持續 {{gr|9|12}} 秒，你對於敵人不會失誤，若該敵人在此降咒效果下死亡，你消除 5% 死亡懲罰。''' *'''{{Skill icon|"以由羅之鎚的力量！" }} 復活音量所及範圍內死去的所有隊友，且體力與能量全滿，持續 30 秒，他們造成的傷害增加 {{gr|25|33}}% ，當效果結束時他們將死去，此技能不會造成死亡懲罰。''' ==2010 12月9日== *暗殺者 :{{skill icon|衝擊強化}}：回復時間提升至 8 秒。 :{{skill icon|狐狸尖牙}}：PvE不動，PvP回復時間提升至 6 秒。 :{{skill icon|暗影微步}}：取消原有的加持限制，改為態勢與加持無法使用 10 秒。 :{{skill icon|野蠻狙殺}}：PvE不動，PvP回復時間提升至 6 秒。 *元素使 :{{skill icon|連鎖閃電}}：回覆時間降至 6 秒。 :{{skill icon|寒風}}：持續時間下降 {{gr|1|5}} 秒，回復時間增加到 7 秒。 :{{skill icon|閃電祈禱}}：施法時間下降至 1 秒，回復時間下降至 8 秒。 *僧侶 :{{skill icon|神賜之盾}}：PvP版本的改為目標其他盟友無法成為負面技能的目標。 :{{skill icon|狀態吸收}}：回覆時間增加至 4 秒。 :{{skill icon|爆發治癒}}：提升治療量至 {{gr|10|160}} 。 :{{skill icon|勤奮精神}}：增加條件，加持提早結束則無效果。 *死靈法師 :{{skill icon|安哥羅頓的凝視}}：改為靈魂吸取屬性，能量獲得提升至 {{gr|5|15}} ，吸血量提升至 {{gr|10|50}} 。 :{{skill icon|汙濁饗宴}}：每轉移一項病症獲得之能量下降至 {{gr|0|2}} ，回覆時間減至 4 秒，增加條件：若成功轉移病症則此技能回覆時間減半。 :{{skill icon|剝奪加持}}：移除加持數量降至 {{gr|0|2}} ，回覆時間提升至 20 秒。 *遊俠 :{{skill icon|致殘之箭}}：回覆時間提升至 4 秒，殘廢時間提升至 {{gr|1|11}} 秒。 :{{skill icon|梅蘭朵射擊}}：回覆時間降至 10 秒。 *祭祀者 :{{skill icon|暗影武裝}}：增加條件：下 {{gr|0|3}} 個被此盟友擊中的敵人盲目5秒。 ==2010 11月12日== *感謝巴友 [http://home.gamer.com.tw/rabbit08679 卡琳提] 翻譯 *暗殺者 :{{skill icon|黑螳螂刺擊}}：增加動作時間為 1 秒，且增加技能回復時間為 6 秒。 :{{skill icon|螳螂之刺}}：減少動作時間為 1/2 秒。 *元素使 :{{skill icon|冰鏡}}：增加回復時間為 45 秒。 *幻術師 :{{skill pages.title: 榮譽值
pages.wikitext:
{{仍需翻譯}}[[巴薩澤]]的[[榮譽值]]可以在{{:Priest of Balthazar}}那邊用來為 [[PvP]] 的人物解除[[技能]]、武器升級部品和符文的[[封印]]。同一帳號中所有的角色共享榮譽值。

== 獲得榮譽值 ==
當你的隊伍殺死敵人或贏得比賽時你會獲得榮譽值，不論你是死是活或身在何處。目前你可以存最多 1'0000 未花的榮譽值。

榮譽值的獎賞:

=== {{:Arena}}: ===
*{{:Ascalon Arena}}
** 殺沒殺過的敵人: 5
** 勝利: 5
** 全隊未死過紅利: 5
** 五連勝紅利: 5
*{{:Shiverpeak Arena}}
** 殺沒殺過的敵人: 10
** 勝利: 10
** 全隊未死過紅利: 10
** 五連勝紅利: 10
*{{:Team Arena}}/{{:Competition Arena}}
** 殺沒殺過的敵人: 20
** 勝利: 25
** 全隊未死過紅利: 25
** 五連勝紅利: 25
=== Tournament ===
* 殺沒殺過的敵人: 20
* 勝利: 
** 初期關卡 100 
** 後期關卡 200
** {{Hall of Heroes}} 400
*全隊未死過紅利: 100

=== [[公會]]對決 ===
* 殺沒殺過的敵人: 20
* 勝利: 500 ~ 2,000 看你公會的評價 (評價 1000 給 500，評價 1600 給 2000)
* 全隊未死過紅利: 100 to 400 看你公會的評價 (評價 1000 給 100，評價 1600 給 400)

==榮譽值花費==
* [[符文]]
** 初級 符文: 1,000 榮譽值
** 中級 符文: 1,500 榮譽值
** 高級 符文: 2,000 榮譽值

* 武器升級部品
** 初級能力: 1,000 榮譽值
** 高級能力: 1,000 榮譽值

* [[技能]]
** 普通技能: 1,000 榮譽值
** 精英技能: 3,000 榮譽值

== 各區有的技能 ==
Priests of Balthazar in level 20 arenas ({{:Tomb of the Primeval Kings (Location)|Tomb of the Primeval Kings}}, {{:Team Arenas}} and {{:Competition Arenas}}) have all skills for all professions including {{:elite skill|elites}}.

Priests of Balthazar in the lower level arenas ({{:Ascalon Arena}} and {{:Shiverpeak Arena}}), which are only accessible to {{:PvE}} characters, do '''not''' have every skill. There is a progression as you proceed from arena to higher level arena. By rule of thumb, the {{:Priest of Balthazar}} in a lower level arena will offer the same skills as the {{:Skill Trainer}} in the adjacent {{:city}}. See {{:Priest of Balthazar}} for details.

如要連結請用 [[FactionPoints]]

pages.title: 槍尖山
歐若拉林地
pages.wikitext:
{{仍需翻譯}}英文:[[guildwiki:Aurora Glade|Aurora Glade]]
[[圖片:12-Aurora_Glade.jpg|thumb|180px|歐若拉林地任務地圖]]
==Description==

''A long time ago, a tribe of human druids ventured into the jungle to make peace with the jungle. For many years they lived in harmony with the Maguuma, making their home in the Aurora Glade. Though there are rumors, no one has actually seen or heard from any of the druids in over a hundred years.''

==NPCs==
*{{Elder Gretchen}}
*{{Machir}} ({{merchant}})
*{{Xunlai Agent}}

*{{Henchmen}} in {{Aurora Glade}} are Level 15
** {{Little Thom}} ({{Brawler}})
** {{Claude}} ({{Cultist}})
** {{Dunham}} ({{Enchanter}})
** {{Reyna}} ({{Archer}})
** {{Orion}} ({{Mage}})
** {{Stefan}} ({{Fighter}})
** {{Alesia}} ({{Healer}})

==Exits==
*{{Ettin's Back}}

==Mission Objectives ==
進入{{Henge of Denravi}}. 
* 前往進入{{Henge Portal}}
* 比{{White Mantle}}更早一步掌握進入{{Henge Portal}}
* '''附加''' 將{{thorn pedestal}}放到荊棘之座上淨化藤蔓之門
* '''隱藏任務''' 刺殺{{Demagogue}}
* '''附加''' 在所有荊棘基座上放置{{thorn pedestal}}淨化藤蔓之門
* '''附加''' 殺死{{Henge Guardian}}.

== Primary ==
The mission begins with an easy but long run through the jungle. Attune the first pedestal to clear the vines blocking the path (A on the map). Fight on until you get to a spot with two pedestals, one on each side (B on the map). To open the way forward, both pedestals need to be attuned with crystals. These can be obtained from the druid at the bottom end of the glade. ''Doing this starts the White Mantle running to attune the Henge Portal, so make sure you have your tactics discussed first.'' If you see someone running to place crystals and you are uncertain that they understand the nature of the mission, wait at the druid until they place the first crystal, then grab the second crystal as soon as it appears. Now you have control of the timing. 

Attune the Henge Portal by attuning all three pedestals with crystals before the White Mantle succeed in attuning them all. The crystals are located at point C on the map and the pedestals at the three point Ds on the map. 
<!-- You must race against the White Mantle who are attempting to activate the druid portals, and have far superior numbers. You need to find and slaughter the White Mantle crystal carriers as quickly as possible, all the while sending your own crystal carriers to also activate the portals. -->

After the pedestals are attuned, a cut scene plays and you are transported into the henge. There you need to kill the Henge Guardian, a level 20 {{Behemoth}}; this should be an easy fight. Afterwards, another cut scene plays and you will find yourself at the {{Henge of Denravi}}.

''Tip:'' One tactic that worked was to let the Mantle claim all but one pedestal. The last one they try to claim is the one directly opposite where they appear from.  To get here, they have to go between two cliff areas and then across a land bridge, providing two natural choke points where it is easy to kill the runners with their crystals.  Place the majority of the group between the two cliffs and another one or two back at the bridge in case the crystal-runner gets through. Often, you can block the runner with your character's body.  Once you have done this, just slay all White Mantle that come out.  When no more come, the bonus mission is trivial, as is claiming all the pedestals.

''Tip:'' Slowing down the Mantle runners makes this quest a lot easier. Therefore, {{Warrior}}s should equip skills like {{Sprint}} and {{Hamstring}}. {{Mesmer}}s, bring along your {{Imagined Burden}} or {{Ethereal Burden}} (whichever lasts longer, based on your skill specializations), or both, if you can, because of the long regeneration times. {{Elementalist}}s have several slowing/knockdown skills, especially in {{Water Magic}} and {{Earth Magic}}. {{Ranger}}s should equip {{Pin Down}}.

''Tip'' If the party isn't interested in doing the bonus or doesn't care, they can simply run the crystals to open the Henge Portal.  With a party of 2 or more, or a single player with speed skills (Rangers take {{Storm Chaser}} and {{Dodge}}, Warriors take {{Sprint}}, Elementalists take {{Armor of Mist}}; reapply when it regenerates), the White Mantle can be outrun to the attunement pedestals.

== Bonus ==
Rescue the ranger {{Less Longbow}} from the White Mantle attacking him (1 on the map). He will tell you of the {{Demagogue}}, a powerful member of the Mantle, whom you should kill.

When you get to the final crystal stage, the Demagogue is positioned near the back where all the White Mantle are coming from (2 on the map).

''Tip:'' One way to complete the bonus is to kill all the Mantle's runners first, and then drive your way to where the Mantle are coming from. This means that at least one pedestal needs to be in the possession of the White Mantle until the bonus is completed. You will need to be extra vigilant in ensuring that all the Mantle runners are dead.

''Tip:'' The safest way to do the bonus is to do the following:
* Capture the pedestal nearest you (immediately to your right as you enter and nearest the crystals pod). 
* Let them take the leftmost pedestal, then kill the forces protecting the pedestal, but do not take it (it is usually the first one taken by them).
* Capture the pedestal nearest the White Mantle (straight across from the one you hold).
* Now, one of your members should stay behind (preferably a Warrior with Sprint, but class makes no difference) and grab a crystal. 
* The White Mantle will try to retake this one consistently. They will send forces there, group by group and their runners will come here.
* Ignore the White Mantle runner. Every time he runs to the pedestal, let him retake it and then have your runner retake it again. The dumb runner will go back to get another crystal; you should have your runner do likewise and wait for him.
* Make it '''very''' clear to your runner that he should not take the third pedestal, otherwise the mission ends before you get the bonus.
* The remaining five members of your group should slowly advance, killing small group after small group until you demolish all the White Mantle forces. In the end, the Demagogue will be left alone and easy to kill. Do not rush the entrance, or you wll be swarmed by a group of 8-10 White Mantle; wait for them to exit group-by-group.

''Tip:'' Another way to do the Bonus is by force-killing the Demagogue. It's the fastest way, but there's no assurance that you can complete the Mission afterwards. So, doing the Bonus this way is meant for players who already did the Mission.
So, as you get the crystal, let the White Mantle attune the left pedestal. Let them go (do not attack) and then attune it yourself. Now, run to the right path, past the middle pedestal, and wait for the White Mantle runner to come back to attune the left pedestal again. As they leave his quarters, rush there (by the right path), ignore the White Mantle there and go straight to the Demagogue. Throw everything you've got at him; hopefully you will kill him and complete the Bonus.

== Bosses ==
*{{Lars the Obeisant}} 
*{{Manton the Indulgent}}
*{{Holt the Iron Boot Heel}}
*{{Garr the Merciful}}
*{{Kenric the Believer}}
*{{Cuthbert the Chaste}}
*{{Tree of Vitality}}

== Skill Capture ==
*{{Searing Heat}} from {{Manton the Indulgent}} (not available before {{Copperhammer Mines}}).
*{{Divine Intervention}} from {{Garr the Merciful}} (not available before {{Copperhammer Mines}}).
*{{Convert Hexes}} from {{Garr the Merciful}} (not available before {{Camp Rankor}}).
*{{Guilt}} from {{Lars the Obeisant}} (not available before {{The Misplaced Sword}} quest at {{Heroes' Audience}}).
*{{Dryder's Defenses}} from {{Cuthbert the Chaste}} (not available before {{Marhan's Grotto}}).
*{{Order of Pain}} from {{Kenric the Believer}} (not available before {{Port Sledge}})
*{{Well of the Profane}} from {{Kenric the Believer}} (not available before {{The Misplaced Sword}} quest at {{Heroes' Audience}})

==Additional Notes==
The players will be in the {{Henge of Denravi}} at the completion of this mission.

pages.title: 死靈法師之路
pages.wikitext:
[[分類:冒險任務]]
英文:[[guildwiki:The Necromancer's Path|The Necromancer's Path]]
==Overview==
'''Summary'''
#去{{Prophet's Path}}並除掉{{Sacred Griffon of Amnoon}}.

'''Obtained from'''
:{{Zratha Kor}} 位於 {{Heroes' Audience}}

'''Requirements'''
:{{Ascension}}
:主、副職業不能夠是 {{Necromancer}}

'''Reward'''
:1,000 {{XP}}

:完成任務之後，可將副職業變更為 {{Necromancer}}.

'''Dialogue'''
:你聽過古蘭斯神的神話嗎？那些無知的傢伙認為死靈法師和我們供奉的神是冷酷的，其實不然，追隨古蘭斯神，就可以脫離幻象，看穿事物的真實面貌。

:你還有機會成為真正的死靈法師。請到先知之路，除掉沙漠居民們崇拜的{{Sacred Griffon of Amnoon}}吧。那你就可以證明你沒有被愚弄很多人的鍍金假神所欺騙。

==Walkthrough==
Start from {{Augury Rock}} and follow the map. The majority of the monsters you will face will be {{Desert Griffon}}s who do {{holy damage}}, so the only tip is not to rely heavily on undead minions.

==Notes==
* ''Tip'': It is a good idea to take the quest {{The Elementalist's Path}} as well (if your character is not an elementalist), as the boss for that quest is also nearby.

pages.title: 死靈法師
pages.wikitext:
{{仍需擴充}}
==簡介==

[[檔案:1_NECRO.jpg|thumb|100px]]

'''死靈法師（Necromancer），他們以人類的身份狂熱地投身到死亡和腐敗的黑暗魔法中。'''

'''希望從人類對死亡的恐懼，得到血魔法之力量。並且施展死亡魔法呼換死者的靈魂，作為亡靈軍團，壓倒敵人。'''

==屬性==
*[[靈魂吸取]] (主要)
**每當非靈的生物在範圍內死去時，依照靈魂吸取等級每級使你獲得1能量，每15秒只能最多獲得三次。
*[[血魔法]]
*[[死亡魔法]]
*[[詛咒]]

==其他==
*[[死靈法師技能描述表]]
*[[Armor Crafting Necromancer|死靈法師防具外觀]]


'''備註''' [[圖像:Necromancer.jpg|right|thumb|250px|死靈法師]]
[[Category:職業]]

pages.title: 武器組及應用
pages.wikitext:
[[Image:Weapon Set.jpg|thumb|right|150px|武器組欄]]
'''武器組'''讓大家可以快速切換四組武器，預設是F1~F4這四個鍵，可以直接把武器拖曳到右下角的武器組欄位中。
[[Image:Enable Weapon Sets.jpg|thumb|150px|right|設定使用的武器組數量]]
預設只有一組武器組，可以在[[gww:Weapon set|裝備物品欄]]視窗更改設定。

==應用==
===進攻組===
*物理職業：可用吸血武器來達到最大傷害。分離需要基本傷害較高，攻速較慢的武器才比較顯著。 另外對付戰士時可準備一套元素傷害的武器。
*法師職業：使用單手杖+聚能器，兩個都是"20%施展時間減半、20%回復時間減半"，常簡稱為40/40，其實是32%機率減半，4%機率四分之一。


===防禦組===
*一個+30HP單手武器以及一個+30HP的盾，基本上就多了60HP與8防禦(大約減少10%傷害)，盾的鑄印可使用"+10防.對於某傷害"。


===加持用===
*大多使用有+20%加持的雙手杖，或者+20%加持單手武器配上聚能器。


===其他===
*PvE拉怪用的長弓。
*低能量組：一個-5能量的單手武器配上一個盾。 由於能量不會扣到負值，可以對付專門燒能量的敵人。
*高能量組：缺能量時可使用"-1能量再生,+15能量"的單手杖和聚能器，但須注意換回來的時候能量可能會停在0，直到回復完畢。

{{Anomaly|若是換武器前先按"動作取消"鍵(預設:ESC)，則換武器時不會有延遲。}}

pages.title: 極地之心
pages.wikitext:
[[File:Hearts of the North banner.jpg|400px]]

*[[極地之心]]([[Hearts of the North]])是[[gww:Guild Wars Beyond|激戰Beyond]](連接GW1和GW2故事的內容)，主要介紹[[gww:Lieutenant Thackeray|中尉薩克雷]]和[[gww:Gwen|關]]的愛情故事，[[科瑞塔戰爭]]後，薩克雷下落不明...

*必須先解完[[科瑞塔戰爭]]主線的所有任務，就是打過The Battle of Lion's Arch，且在[[史蹟殿堂]]看過小隊向[[gww:Gwen|關]]回報薩克雷失蹤的對話後，接下來依下列步驟進行。

== 尋找薩克雷 ==
[[File:Embedded Arrowhead.jpg|right|thumb|鑲嵌箭頭位置]]
[[File:Tarnished Emblem.jpg|right|thumb|黯淡的紋章位置]]
[[File:The Broken Sword.jpg|right|thumb|斷劍位置]]
[[File:Shining Blade Cloak.png|right|thumb|光刃斗篷位置]]
[[圖片:443.jpg|thumb|right|Reunion任務中，薩克雷的位置]]
# 在[[gww:Eye of the North (outpost)|極地之眼]]外面的[[冰崖裂口]]可看見一名[[黑檀先鋒隊偵查兵]]，他會暗示找尋中尉的線索。
#* 在[[瞭望塔海岸]]找尋[[Embedded Arrowhead]](鑲嵌箭頭)，在[[甲蟲鎮]]外 (按ALT較方便找)，點選它接取任務。
# 回到史蹟殿堂找關，她會給你[[Keiran's Bow]]，把Keiran's Bow裝備起來。
#* 和[[占卜池]]對話，開啟第一個任務：[[Auspicious Beginnings]](好運的開始) (點''{{yes}}Show me the story of the arrowhead.'')。
#* 完成後，聽完關的對話，若是她開始重覆相同的話語，重新進入史蹟殿堂。
# 在[[王者安息處]]找尋[[Tarnished Emblem]](黯淡的紋章)，過[[賢者領地]]傳點立即看到，點選它接取任務。
#* 回到史蹟殿堂，把Keiran's Bow裝備起來，和占卜池對話進入第二個任務：[[A Vengeance of Blades]](復仇刀鋒) (點''{{yes}}Show me the story of the tarnished emblem.'')。
#* 完成後，聽完關的對話。
# 在[[雙頭怪隱匿地]]，找尋[[Broken Sword]](斷劍)，就在"雙"字附近，點選它接取任務。
#* 回到史蹟殿堂，把Keiran's Bow裝備起來，和占卜池對話進入第三個任務：[[Shadows in the Jungle]](密林陰影) (點''{{yes}}Show me the story of the broken sword.'')。
# 在[[瞭望塔海岸]]找尋[[Shining Blade Cloak]](光刃斗篷)，就在"瞭"字附近，點選它接取任務。
#* 回到史蹟殿堂，把Keiran's Bow裝備起來，和占卜池對話進入第四個任務：[[Rise]](奮起) (點''{{yes}}Show me the story of the Mantle's guise.'')。
# 完成後，關會給新任務[[Reunion]](重聚)。
#* 在隊伍中加[[關]]，到[[鐵砧石]]尋找中尉，他就在"鐵砧石"三字上方。
#* 回到史蹟殿堂拿取任務獎勵，重新進來就可以看到中尉向關求婚的對話。
#* 這一系列任務解完有 8 個[[榮譽勳章]]。

==婚禮準備==
# 可在史蹟殿堂和薩克雷接取[[Norn Catering]](諾恩酒席)任務。
#* 到[[糾結之艾卡茲亞]]獵捕[[Alpha Tyrannus]](泰拉紐斯首領)。
#* 從[[杜漢姆卷藏室]]進入[[哀傷之幕瀑布]]搜尋[[Elusive Black Moa]](難以搜尋的黑恐鳥)，這隻恐鳥會一直消失，需不斷的跟著任務綠點走，到最後恐鳥會停下來變成敵對狀態，同時周圍會出現許多看守者伏兵。
#* 進入[[希伯欣花園]]探索區域，獵捕三隻[[Ripened Mirage Ibogas]](鮮美幻象伊波伽)。
[[圖片:Ripened Mirage Ibogas map.jpg|thumb|right|三隻鮮美幻象伊波伽位置]]
==小技巧==
{{ Skill bar
 | 1 = 基爾瑞恩的狙擊箭
 | 2 = 墓碑標籤
 | 3 = 終端之速
 | 4 = 箭雨
 | 5 = 無情突襲
 | 6 = 自然祝福
 | 7 = 「找出弱點！」(夏克瑞)
 | 8 = 「無須懼怕！」(夏克瑞)
}}
*Miku會用Promise of Death，跟著她的降咒目標，用第一招Keiran's Sniper Shot，可造成大量傷害。
*Keiran專精有20，除了Keiran's Sniper Shot以外都盡量用。
*盡量不要讓Miku死，她死了要殺死對手會困難許多。

==重要人物==

*{{me}} 20 [[關]]
*{{r}} 20 [[基爾瑞恩 薩克雷]](Keiran Thackeray)
*{{w}}/{{mo}} 20 [[Danthor the Adamant]]

pages.wikitext:
{{quotation|[[Feedback:Developer updates/20110428|Developer updates]]|上次 [[萬聖節]]，在[[狂人宮廷]]中的臣民一個個計畫不同的陰謀，想要釋放 [[瘋狂南瓜王]]。封印被打破，怪異行為表現，可怕的笑話被破譯，它在當時看來，所有的小題大做都是白費心力。 

但此後，不穩定已經開始滲透到世界各地，聚集在地方的影響 [[迷霧]]是感覺最強烈。的不穩定造成的波動 - 變化，改變了經驗打在我們的競爭場地。波動似乎來來去去，帶來新的影響與他們每個月。 

每個月的第一天，[[gww:Flux|流量]](Flux)出現在[[PvP]]區域，會產生不同影響。}}

pages.title: 永恆之林
pages.wikitext:
永恆之林HM單人大師 
巴友:memorywind 發言日期: 2010-09-14 01:19:56 
   
http://forum.gamer.com.tw/C.php?bsn=07678&snA=19578&tnum=3

很多人認為永恆之林是沒辦法單人大師的，今天就趁睡前來跟大家打破一下這個迷思
首先呢，你的角色技能組合必須具有以下幾個特點
 
1.遠距離攻擊：在避開勒克森弓箭手的情形下攻擊海龜炮
2.中毒、流血.......等病症或扣血的降咒，來避開海龜的高減傷或有無視裝甲的暗影傷害
3.加速跑技，來快速游擊

主角聖/祭

荊棘之矛.瀝血.痛苦倒轉.全體備戰!.攻擊要害!.堅守崗位!.絕不投降!.敵人來襲!.
[OQCiUym8AkBAAAAgFuG7j5xA]

英雄帶招靈+招骨+火元或支配幻，插旗守一路
傭兵帶雙僧+死靈+火或支配幻，插旗守另一路

腐化膽汁.恐懼骸骨.失魂紋章.受虐.血之祭典.惡魔骸骨.爬行骸骨.巫妖靈氣 
[OABDQTxGTKgTBVVbhdCUBHVyBA]

爆裂火焰.隕石.灼熱凝視.強力吸收.榨取紋章.回復靈氣.火之調和.元素力量符號
[OgVEIzUKz7Q32Fj1MQPgWgLMGA]

爆刺武裝.苦惱.聯合.血歌.苦痛.極痛.缚靈紋章.苦痛連結
[OACiAyiMhxEt94UO9N1JeNVNBA] 

傭兵-僧/佳美.僧/救贖者克魯司.死/依芙.幻/埃里斯 維思柏.

第一隻海龜會從上路出現，可以很輕鬆的從另一側避開弓箭手解決海龜

第二隻海龜會從左側出現，這隻海龜很容易引到弓箭手
對自己角色有信心可以用耗的把海龜耗死，不然抓準敵人出現的空檔把英雄的插旗取消，快速解決這隻海龜也是一種方法。

第三隻海龜從右側出現，這隻由於敵人佔位問題所以也是很好解決
從下方接近之後就能在不引到弓箭手情形下殺掉

後面的打法就是很重複了，其實只要有信心把上方來的海龜單人殺掉。
左右兩邊的海龜都可以取消插旗拉出去解決而不讓敵人趁隙鑽進去。
海龜的殺傷力其實沒有到很有威脅的地步，除非你讓同一路同時存在兩隻以上的海龜
不然等他砲擊CD跑完詩人的血大概也回滿了，出去殺海龜的時間點是在解決會殺進本鎮的勒克森人後馬上出去，如果自己引到這些敵人而死在外面會很麻煩。

接下來的被感染群就跟一般人解沒啥兩樣了
我的做法是會兩邊門口插靈，因為距離夠遠所以靈可以同時存在

江湖一點訣，不值半毛錢...XD
永恆之林大師真的不難...雖然當初我也曾經認為他牢不可破
不過在經過一段時間沒公會沒同盟一匹狼獨闖天涯後......
什麼單人硬搞自虐事情真的幹了不少...XDD
 
IGN:Kappa River [EW]

[[圖片:13-Riverside_Province.jpg|thumb|180px|河畔地帶任務攻略]]
==Description==
''The {{Ullen River}} originates from the farthest south of the {{Footprint Lakes}}. The River flows west into the {{Maguuma Jungle|jungle}}, then turns decidedly south at the {{Henge of Denravi}}. Its swift currents and shallow inlets would make it an ideal trading river but for the fact that there are few settlements on its backs.''

==NPCs==
*{{Blade Warrior Derikk}}
*{{Samuel}} ({{Merchant}})
*{{Xunlai Agent}}
*{{Henchmen}} in {{Riverside Province}} are Level 15
** {{Little Thom}} (Brawler)
** {{Claude}} (Cultist)
** {{Dunham}} (Enchanter)
** {{Reyna}} (Archer)
** {{Orion}} (Mage)
** {{Stefan}} (Fighter)
** {{Alesia}} (Healer)

==Exits==
*{{Twin Serpent Lakes}}

==Mission Objectives ==
Steal the {{Scepter of Orr}}.
* Avoid detection on your way to the temple.
* Talk to {{Dinas}} to get the scepter.
* Escape to the bridge to the northeast.
* '''BONUS''' Take out the Watchman at each tower, so {{Saidra}} can get the weapons through.

== Primary ==
You can complete this mission and kill almost no {{White Mantle}}. Simply keep hugging the left wall;  with a compact group and correct timing (waiting where necessary), the White Mantle will not see you. At each tower, hug the left and you should be past (and through the gate where appropriate) before the White Mantle spread out and block the path. Since the White Mantle are in large groups, this can be a much easier way through the mission. The red path shown on the map is the shortest, but there are many others.

After collecting the scepter at point A on the map, pass through the gate and again keep hugging the left wall. Eventually, you get to a pair of towers surrounded by loads of White Mantle. Look carefully and you will see a boss and a narrow bridge between the towers (B on the map). Pass quickly through the White Mantle, kill the boss, and pass along the bridge to complete the mission.

''Tip:'' If you are rushing between those two towers to the boss, make sure the boss is not blocking the path through to the bridge. If he is, fall back ({{pull}}ing him from where he is) and rush again.

== Bonus ==
Kill all the {{Watchtower Guard}}s (9 of them)—one up in each tower. This involves killing nearly all the White Mantle surrounding them, as well as the {{White Mantle Seeker}}s standing next to the Guards up in the tower. 

Despite the seemingly contradicting goals, this bonus and the first goal in the primary objective are both possible. You can wipe out all the White Mantle on the map and then talk to Dinas, and you will not have violated the ''avoid detection'' goal. 

In general, each tower has two {{White Mantle Savant}}s or {{White Mantle Ritualist|Ritualists}} on the ground guarding it and two archers on top (the Watchtower Guard and a Seeker). However, as you approach each {{Watchtower}}, the guard will call all surrounding groups; this will bring in 3-4 groups of 2-3 White Mantle. They will then spread out searching the area. Then, if nothing happens, each group will go away. There are a few ways to deal with these groups: 
*Take them out few-by-few after they scatter. 
*Wait till the guard sounds the all-clear and then hunt each group separately, away from the tower.

At the first watchtower, you'll see some guards having a short conversation (first X on the map). After a while, all of them will spread out in small groups around the tower. Make sure to have decent ranged attacks, as the Watchtower Guards have {{Troll Unguent}}. After you kill them, this will open the bonus; talk to Saidra (Z on the map), and she'll give you the bonus objective. The gate will open next to her, revealing a tower that is otherwise unreachable. Use the same tactics on this tower and all the rest in the mission (towers are marked with X on the map).

''Tip:'' Try to pull very carefully—about 3 at a time—otherwise you will be overpowered. It may be worth working to the port, and then back to the Scepter, since that way you only need one survivor to complete the mission itself for you, in case of a wipe.

''Tip:'' The White Mantle up in the Tower can in fact be attacked with melee weapons. You have to walk up as close to the front gate of the tower as possible. From here, you also have a chance to recover items dropped on top of the tower. This doesn't always work, though.

''Tip:'' Try to do the bonus first if you plan on doing both bonus and primary mission. The reason is that should disaster fall and you be unable to resurrect some of your party, you can then go back and speak to Dinas. The cut scene will resurrect your fallen members.

==Skill Capture==

*  {{Convert Hexes}} from {{Corbin the Upright}} (not available before {{Camp Rankor}}).

{{BeastInfo | name = Mhenlo | image = [[Image:Mhenlo.JPG|128px]] | species = [[人類]] | prof = 僧侶 | icon = [[Image:Monk-icon.png]] | level = 4..20}} [[Mhenlo]] was born in [[Serenity Temple]] to a priestess of [[Dwayna]] and a priest of [[Balthazar]]. Although he was tutored in the magic of both these [[Gods of Tyria|gods]], he does not use any [[Smiting Prayers]] in the game. He is a member of the [[Heroes of Ascalon]]. ==使用技能== *[[首部曲傭兵技能一覽#超越之路以後|阿斯卡隆戰記]] *[[二部曲傭兵技能一覽|盟與敵]] *[[三部曲傭兵技能一覽|黑暗逆襲]] *[[極地之眼傭兵技能一覽|極地之眼]] ==Lore== Lore from the [http://www.guildwars.com/theworld/tyria/characters/aidan.php official website]: :'''Nation:''' [[Ascalon]] :'''Birthplace:''' [[Serenity Temple]] :'''Age:''' 22 :''Born in Serenity Temple to a priest of Dwayna and priestess of Balthazar, Mhenlo has been steeped in the teachings of healing and smiting magic. A devoted servant of both Dwayna and Balthazar, he has studied hard his entire life, and has been rewarded by both the gods of his provenance. But paying allegiance to two gods has not been without its consequences; without a clear path to follow, Mhenlo has a tendency to over-analyze situations and possible consequences, not sure whether to take the path of aggressive strength or that of defensive grace.'' :''Mhenlo has spent much of his life inside Serenity Temple, paying homage to the old gods and studying the Path, which will lead him to enlightenment. He is rather timid as the story begins, not completely trusting of his magical prowess. But with [[Cynn]]'s help he gains confidence and becomes more comfortable with his considerable power.''
==Mhenlo, NPC== In the [[Prophecies Campaign]], Brother Mhenlo is one of the Monks of [[Ashford Abbey]] and is a [[Profession Trainer]] for new Monk characters. After the [[Searing]], he can be found helping the survivors of [[Ascalon]] and, later on, making several other appearances with [[Devona]], [[Aidan]], and [[Cynn]] as the [[campaign]] progresses. Also of note is that there are several indications of a bond beginning to form between Mhenlo and Cynn, hinting at a growing romance, most notably in the quest [[The Wayward Monk]] and the above lore. It was revealed in the [[Factions Campaign]] that Mhenlo was a former student of [[Master Togo]] of [[Shing Jea Monastery]]. Master Togo had sent a request for aid and Mhenlo readily traveled to [[Cantha]] to answer the call. His group of friends (Devona, Aidan, [[Eve]], and Cynn) accompanied him. It would also later reveal that Mhenlo is on good terms with the [[Kurzick]]s as the group of friends traveled to the [[Echovald Forest]] to seek aid. This campaign would play up and provide stronger indications of his romantic relationship with Cynn. The [[Nightfall Campaign]] also features Mhenlo and his friends, which implies that they have also answered [[Kormir]]'s call for help. They would aid the [[Sunspears]] as they sought to avert an apocalyse. ===Quests=== {| border="0" cellspacing="3" |- style="background: #EEE" ! Prophecies !! Factions !! He does, however, sometimes run up to the frontlines to use Healing Touch, which immediately focuses enemy attention on him. '''Pros''' *Solid healer who, coupled with [[Lina]], can sustain a party very well. *Often faster and more effective at healing than [[Alesia]]. '''Cons''' *Very fragile. *Has the same [[resurrect (Action)|resurrection]] issues as [[Lina]]. ==Information==
''Note: [[Tyria]] and [[Elona]] are adjacent to each other as parts of the same [[wikipedia:supercontinent|supercontinent]].''

The Tyrian continent is the location where most of the [[Prophecies Campaign]] took place.  The earliest known intelligent life began on Tyria 3000 years ago, though there are signs of creatures estimated to be from roughly ten thousand years ago.  It is also known that the [[Gods of Tyria]] used to live in Tyria (in the present-day ruins of [[Orr]]) for some time prior to the [[Exodus of the Gods|Exodus]]. The official calendar in Tyria is the [[Mouvelian Calendar]].  Tyrians use [[writing systems]] that differ from known languages, and thus the actual signs on roads cannot be read (thankfully, the user's language is used to help with directions).  

Tyria contains many [[Region]]s that vary greatly in geography, and civilization.

Tyria has seven regions, six of which can be explored:
#[[Ascalon]].
#The [[Shiverpeak Mountains]], which are divided into the regions [[Northern Shiverpeaks]], [[Southern Shiverpeaks]] and [[Sorrow's Furnace (region)|Sorrow's Furnace]].
#[[Kryta]].
#The [[Maguuma Jungle]].
#The [[Crystal Desert]], which contains access to the [[Ruins of the Tomb of the Primeval Kings]].
#The [[Ring of Fire Islands]].
#The shattered peninsula of [[Orr]], which cannot be accessed at this point in time.

==How Do I Get There?==
You start off on the continent of Tyria if you create a [[Prophecies]] character, but if you create a character in [[Cantha]] or [[Elona]], you will have to unlock travel to Tyria via the appropriate [[quest]].

* [[Factions]] characters wishing to travel to Tyria for the first time should seek out [[Guardsman Chienpo]] in [[Kaineng Center]] and take the "[[Chaos in Kryta]]" quest.
* [[Nightfall]] characters wishing to travel to Tyria for the first time should seek out [[Deras Tenderlin]] in [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]] and take the "[[Terror in Tyria]]" quest.
*You can travel from Elona to Tyria and from Tyria to Elona by talking to the [[Forgotten Guardian]] in [[The Arid Sea]] (Tyria) or in the [[Crystal Overlook]] (Elona). You must have already been to the [[Crystal Desert]] in Tyria to travel from Elona to Tyria in this way, and you must be able to survive [[the Desolation]] by being able to summon the [[Junundu]] if you wish to travel from Tyria to Elona.

Likewise, you can travel to Elona or Cantha from Tyria if you have their respective campaigns, [[Nightfall]] or [[Factions]]. 

* Tyrian characters may travel to Cantha using the quest "[[Mhenlo's Request]]" which is offered by [[Firstwatch Sergio]] in [[Lion's Arch]]. 
* Tyrian characters may travel to Elona using the quest “[[Sunspears in Kryta]]" which is offered by [[Lionguard Figo]] in [[Lion's Arch]].

pages.title: 泰瑞亞(世界)
pages.wikitext:
{{Location box| name= Tyria (world)| image=[[image:Tyria.jpg|250px]]| type=World|campaign=Core|parent=[[The Mists]]|neighbors= align=center {{pipe}} None}}
[[Tyria]] is the world in which most of the game is played. Currently the known [[continent]]s in the world of Tyria are [[Tyria (Continent)|Tyria]] (of the same name), [[Cantha]], [[Elona]], and the [[PvP]] archipelago known as [[The Battle Isles]]. Also, in the Guild Wars Nightfall Manuscripts, it is stated that, in 731 CC, Cantha began trading with the "northern areas", along with [[Tyria (continent)|Tyria]] and [[Elona]]. Whether they will be included in future campaigns is yet to be seen.

The world of Tyria also has the following seas and oceans:
*The Unending Ocean.
*The [[Sea of Sorrows]], formerly known as the [[Bay of Sirens]].

Additionally, there are two former seas:
*[[The Jade Sea]] (original name unknown), which was petrified in the [[Jade Wind]].
*The [[Crystal Sea]], which was destroyed in the war between the Margonites and the followers of the [[Gods of Tyria|Five Gods]], becoming the [[Crystal Desert]].

Legend has it that Tyria was the first created world and that after the [[Exodus of the Gods|Exodus]], the [[Gods of Tyria|Gods]] went on to create other worlds.

It is not known if Tyria is a globe or a [[wikipedia:flat Earth|flat world]].

pages.title: 活動簡報參閱
pages.wikitext:
{{TOCright}}'''Happy 19th Anniversary，Guild Wars ! 
To celebrate the nineteen anniversary of Guild Wars，we will be holding a special event on the festivities，check out the [http://wiki.guildwars.com/wiki/Anniversary_Celebration Guild Wars Wiki]。'''

==主體活動==
'''''+8GMT  ''4/23 凌晨3:00 ~ 5/6 凌晨3:00'''

* 為慶祝激戰邁入19週年(2005 ~ 2024)。[http://wiki.guildwars.com/wiki/Feedback:Game_updates/20150422 (為期兩周)]

* 二章星岬夜市(九宮格彩票)、一章獅門、三章卡瑪丹(龍之競技場+甲蟲競速)。

* [[gww:Great Temple of Balthazar|巴薩澤聖殿]]有勝利勳章兌換禮品。

* 打怪掉落生日杯子蛋糕。

* 發行[[gww:Birthday Present Voucher|Birthday Present Voucher]](生日禮卷)。帳號綁定，無法交易。自2013後，玩家的角色，每年的生日時，將收到一張生日禮卷，可找各區的[[gww:Xunlai Gift-Giver|Xunlai Gift-Giver]](桑萊禮品贈與者)兌換一個請[[gww:Birthday Present|Birthday Present]](生日禮物)，隨機獲得特殊迷你寵物。

* 前往[[gww:Embark Beach|Embark Beach]](征途海灘)船上找神秘女 [[gww:Ceira, Sworn to Fire|Ceira, Sworn to Fire]]對話。可以解鎖遊俠寵物 [[gww:Hound of Balthazar|巴薩澤之犬]]。


==2015年：十週年新NPC與新道具==
[[檔案:Palora,_Sworn_to_Earth.jpg|130px|thumb|left]]

'''1.''' 用'''任何模式'''解完任一個主線任務，系統會贈送1枚'''[[gww:Proof of Legend|Proof of Legend]](傳奇憑證)'''。
* '''注意！完成任務時，物品欄不能全滿'''。

* '''同角色在同區域只能拿到一枚'''。(例如打了帝國聖所，同樣角色再打萊蘇皇宮就沒有)

[[檔案:Proof_of_Legend.jpg|thumb|43px|十週年慶新道具-傳奇憑證]]

[[檔案:Blessing_of_War.jpg|100px|thumb|right]]

[[檔案:無名島_戰承武器商.jpg|100px|thumb]]

[[檔案:巴薩澤金武.jpg|100px|thumb]]

[[檔案:營雄之路_戰承武器商.jpg|100px|thumb]]

[[檔案:經典十週年戰承寶箱.jpg|100px|thumb]]

* 一章可拿6枚憑證 ([[gww:Ascalon|阿斯卡隆區]]、[[gww:Shiverpeaks|南部席娃山脈]]、[[gww:Kryta|科瑞塔區]]、[[gww:Maguuma Jungle|梅古瑪叢林]]、[[gww:Crystal Desert|水晶沙漠]]、[[gww:Ring of Fire|火環群島]])，各區域挑一個主線解。

* 二章可拿5枚憑證 ([[gww:Shing Jea Island|星岬島]]、[[gww:Kaineng City|凱寧城]]、[[gww:Jade Sea|碧玉海]]、[[gww:Echovald Forest|科凡德森林]]、[[gww:Raisu Palace|萊蘇皇宮]])，各區域挑一個主線解。

* 三章可拿5枚憑證 ([[gww:Istan|伊斯坦島]]、[[gww:Kourna|高楠區]]、[[gww:Vabbi|瓦貝區]]、[[gww:Desolation|荒蕪之地]]、[[gww:Realm of Torment|苦痛領域]])，各區域挑一個主線解。

* 資料片可拿4枚憑證 ([[gww:Far Shiverpeaks|北部席娃山脈]]、[[gww:Charr Homelands|夏爾家園區]]、[[gww:Tarnished Coast|灰暗沿岸]]、[[gww:Depths of Tyria|泰瑞亞深處]])，各區域挑一個主線解。

* 可快速解完的主線：占卜之石、沉睡之水、帝國聖所、夏貝克村莊、希貝克大宮廷、摩拉廢墟、亞霸頓之門、英雄的光彩年代。

'''2.''' 拿傳奇憑證給Embark Beach船上的[[gww:Palora, Sworn to Earth|Palora, Sworn to Earth]]看一下，可以解開一個20格免費四周年倉庫頁。

*若是以前四週年時有拿過這個倉庫頁，NPC則會給'''[[gww:Blessing of War|Blessing of War]](戰爭祈福勳章)'''。

'''3.''' 收集5枚憑證，回到Embark Beach與[[gww:Ancient Anniversary Weaponsmith|Ancient Anniversary Weaponsmith]](古老節慶武器商)兌換'''[[gww:Decade weapons|Decade系列]]'''。(經典十週年綠武)。

* Decade系列武器外觀以及'''特效'''，請參考[https://www.ptt.cc/bbs/GuildWars/M.1429892754.A.B2C.html 這個PTT頁面]

* '''注意！一兌換就會立即個人化，請先把憑證給想要的角色'''。

'''4.''' 也可使用5枚憑證換1枚戰爭祈福勳章，前往巴薩澤聖殿外面的[[gww:Isle of the Nameless|無名島]]，找戰承武器商兌換'''[[gww:Gallery_of_Balthazar's_weapons|戰神系列]]'''。(巴薩澤金武，可鑄印)

'''5.''' PvP場 [[英雄之路]]也有十週年紀念寶箱獲得。請與戰承教官 [[gww:Anzhaer, Hammer of Balthazar|Anzhaer, Hammer of Balthazar]]接取任務 [[gww:Pilgrimage to the Hall of Heroes|Pilgrimage to the Hall of Heroes]](英雄之路朝聖)，組隊出戰，贏得勝利，可獲得5000經驗值、2白金、1枚'''[[gww:Proof of Steel|Proof of Steel]](鋼鐵憑證)'''，再找戰承僧侶兌換。


==2020年：十五週年新項目==
'''今年新增的項目有：'''
[[檔案:十五週年慶新道具-凱旋憑證.png|thumb|43px|十五週年慶新道具-凱旋憑證 ]]
[[檔案:十五週年慶金武.png|thumb|100px]]

'''1.''' 新增'''[[gww:Proof of Triumph|Proof of Triumph]](凱旋憑證)'''
*接洽於征途海灘古老節慶武器商，使用5枚'''[[gww:Proof of Legend|Proof of Legend]]'''傳奇憑證兌換。

'''2.''' 新增十把'''[[gww:Category:Anniversary weapons|Anniversary系列]](週年慶金武)'''
*使用5枚傳奇憑證兌換，可鑄印。

'''3.''' 新增十個PvE精英技能
*分布在三個章節與一個資料片的後段區域。


'''職業精英技能捕捉前置：'''

'''1.''' 自備'''[[gww:Proof of Triumph|凱旋憑證]]'''
*會提示魔王位置，隊伍內有一人攜帶即可。

'''2.''' 自備'''[[gww:Signet of Capture|捕捉紋章]]'''
*獵殺相同主職或副職的魔王，獲得精英技。

[[檔案:激戰十五週年生日慶典_獵殺魔王_Abaddon's_Cursed.png|thumb|100px]]
[[檔案:激戰十五週年生日慶典_獵殺魔王_Blade_Ancient_Syu-Shai.png|thumb|100px]]
[[檔案:激戰十五週年生日慶典_獵殺魔王_Yoannh_the_Rebuilder.png|thumb|100px]]
[[檔案:激戰十五週年生日慶典_獵殺魔王_Fureyst_Sharpsight.png|thumb|100px]]


'''獵殺行動開始：'''
*'''前往一章[[gww:Ember Light Camp|殘火營地]]'''，外面的破滅石探索區，獵殺魔王[[gww:Addison's Cursed|Addison's Cursed]]。
*捕捉死靈精英技 [[gww:Soul Taker|Soul Taker]]
*捕捉元素精英技 [[gww:Over the Limit|Over the Limit]]

pages.title: 無懼者之丘
pages.wikitext:
{{仍需翻譯}}[[Category:南席娃山脈]]
==Description==
'''Dreadnought's Drift''' is an {{explorable area}} that lies near the midway point between the {{Northern Shiverpeaks}} and the {{Southern Shiverpeaks}}. Though it is relatively small, groups fighting through here will not find it easy. Huge mobs and surprising spawns make this one of the hardest areas of the game.

''Note:'' This area is the second area passed through on the {{Droknar Run}}.

==Exits / Neighbour Areas==
*North: {{Lornar's Pass}}
*South: {{Snake Dance}}

==Bestiary==

===Monsters===
*{{Stone Summit}}: They make up a majority of the enemies in the area, and are concentrated into two large groups near the southern and northern branches of the pass . There is also a group of 7-8 {{Stone Summit Carver}}s on the western path, as well as a group of 7-8 {{Stone Summit Scout}}s in the northwestern part of the area. Small, clustered groups can be found in the southereastern valley.
*{{Tundra Giant}}s: Large groups can be found near the southwestern exit and in the southeastern corner.
*{{Blessed Griffon}} There is a large group in a little enclave prior to the southwestern exit.
*{{Azure Shadow}}: Uniquely in this area, they will pop out after the stationary groups of Stone Summit (in the eastern part of the area) are killed off.

===Bosses and Elite Skills===
*{{Maw The Mountain Heart}}, {{Wurm (Species)|Wurm}} ({{Feast of Corruption}})

===NPCs===

===Chests===
There are two unique (and unlocked) chests in this area. 

*Frozen Chest: Found in the southeastern part of the area, near the statue of {{Dwayna}}. 
*Lost Strongbox: Found near the furnace at the northern end of the western valley.

===Statues===
There is a {{God's statue|statue}} of {{Dwayna}} in the southwestern part of the area. The {{avatar}} of this statue offers the usual {{God's statue#Gods' Blessings|blessings}}.
